Paid per video, per task — no fixed salary

Software you're most comfortable in

title: Full-Time Book Layout Designer / Editorial Graphic Designer
description:
We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Book Layout Designer / Editorial Graphic Designer for a long-term full-time remote position.



This is not a one-time freelance project. We are looking for one individual person who wants to work with us consistently, 5 days per week, for a stable long-term collaboration in the book publishing field.



The main focus of this role is professional book formatting and editorial layout design, especially for non-fiction books, guides, workbooks, manuals, planners and educational content.



We are not looking for simple Word formatting or basic template work. We are looking for someone who understands clean editorial design, page structure, typography, spacing, margins, print-ready files and professional visual organization.



This role also requires the ability to create and adapt visual assets for books and publishing projects. The right person should be able to research suitable visual references, create custom visual elements, icons, diagrams, simple illustrations and AI-assisted images when needed, always following the style, target audience and quality requirements of each specific project.



Main responsibilities:



* Professional book interior formatting and layout design

* Editorial page design for non-fiction books, guides, manuals, workbooks and planners

* Creation of clean tables, boxes, callouts, checklists and structured visual elements

* Creation or adaptation of visual assets such as icons, diagrams, simple illustrations and image-based elements

* Use of AI tools, when appropriate, to support the creation of book visuals, references, illustrations or graphic elements

* Research of suitable images, references and visual styles based on the project target and requirements

* Preparation of print-ready PDF files

* Correct use of trim size, margins, bleed and safe areas

* Layout adjustments for paperback and digital formats

* Revisions based on detailed written feedback

* File organization and respect for deadlines

* Support with other book-related graphic tasks when needed, such as cover layout, Amazon A+ Content, book mockups and social media ad creatives



Required skills:



* Strong eye for editorial layout and clean page design

* Experience with book formatting, publishing design or print layout

* Good knowledge of Adobe InDesign or other professional layout software

* Understanding of typography, spacing, hierarchy and visual consistency

* Ability to create or adapt visual elements that fit the style and target audience of a project

* Ability to research visual references and images with attention to quality, consistency and usage rights

* Ability to use AI tools thoughtfully for visual creation, concept development or image support

* Ability to prepare print-ready PDF files

* Good written English

* Ability to follow detailed written instructions

* Reliable internet connection and own computer

* Long-term mindset and professional attitude



Preferred skills:



* Amazon KDP formatting experience

* Adobe Photoshop

* Adobe Illustrator

* Canva

* AI image generation tools

* Experience with book covers, Amazon A+ Content, mockups or advertising creatives

* Experience with non-fiction books, workbooks, planners, guides or educational materials

* Ability to create icons, diagrams, infographics, visual aids and simple custom illustrations



Important:

We are not looking for an agency. Individual applicants only.



This is a full-time long-term role, 40 hours per week, 5 days per week.



Salary: $400–$500/month depending on experience and skill level.



To apply, please answer these questions clearly:



1. Are you applying as an individual or as an agency?

2. Are you available full-time, 40 hours per week?

3. What is your expected monthly salary in USD?

4. What is your time zone?

5. Which professional layout and design tools do you use?

6. Do you have experience with Adobe InDesign or similar layout software?

7. Have you ever formatted books, workbooks, planners, manuals or guides?

8. Do you understand trim size, margins, bleed, safe areas and print-ready PDF export?

9. Please share your 3 most relevant portfolio examples related to book layout, publishing design, print design or editorial design.

10. Can you create or adapt custom visual elements such as icons, diagrams, simple illustrations, infographics or visual aids for books?

11. Do you use AI tools for visual creation, image generation, concept development or design support? If yes, which tools?

12. Are you able to research images and visual references while respecting quality, consistency and usage rights?

13. Are you also able to work on book-related graphics such as covers, Amazon A+ Content, mockups or social media creatives?

14. Are you comfortable receiving detailed written feedback and making revisions?

15. Please write “BOOK-LAYOUT-2026” at the top of your application so we know you read the full job post.



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a small paid test task using fictional material. The test will only be used internally to evaluate skills and will not be published or used commercially.

title: ClickUp Project Manager (Websites and SEO)
description:
# Full-Time Project Manager for Web Design and SEO Agency



## About Frisco Web Agency



Frisco Web Agency is a growing web design and digital marketing agency based in Frisco, Texas. Our primary service is designing and developing custom websites for service-based businesses. We also manage ongoing Search Engine Optimization campaigns and occasionally take on other digital projects.



We are currently a small team of three:



* Christopher Potter — Owner

* Rocky Diana — Web Developer

* Melissa Saldana — Administrative Support



We are looking for a full-time Project Manager who can take ownership of our client projects, organize our fulfillment process, and keep everything moving forward without requiring constant direction.



## The Main Outcome of This Role



The most important responsibility of this position is simple:



**Make sure every project continues moving forward and is completed on time—or preferably ahead of schedule.**



As the owner, Christopher needs to focus more of his time on marketing, sales, strategy, and growing the company. Right now, managing multiple active projects can pull him away from those responsibilities.



Your role will be to take ownership of the day-to-day management of our fulfillment.



You will need to know:



* Where every project currently stands

* What has already been completed

* What still needs to be completed

* Who is responsible for each task

* What is due next

* What is falling behind

* What information we are waiting on

* What the client needs to know

* What could prevent us from meeting a deadline



We do not want someone who only updates tasks after being told what to do. We need someone who thinks ahead, identifies problems early, communicates clearly, and actively pushes projects toward completion every day.



## Primary Responsibilities



### Manage Website Projects



Most of your work will involve managing custom website design and development projects.



You will be responsible for:



* Setting up and organizing projects in ClickUp

* Reviewing each active project every day

* Creating and assigning tasks

* Confirming that tasks have clear descriptions, deadlines, and owners

* Following up with team members about incomplete or overdue work

* Identifying the next steps before the current steps are completed

* Coordinating design, content, development, revisions, quality assurance, and launch

* Gathering missing information and materials from clients

* Communicating project updates to clients

* Preventing projects from becoming stalled

* Keeping projects on schedule and pushing for early completion

* Escalating problems before they become emergencies



### Manage SEO Campaigns



Website projects will be the primary responsibility, but you will also help manage ongoing SEO campaigns.



This may include:



* Organizing monthly SEO deliverables in ClickUp

* Confirming that assigned SEO work is completed

* Coordinating content, website updates, keyword research, on-page optimization, and reporting

* Tracking recurring monthly responsibilities

* Preparing client updates

* Following up on missing approvals or information

* Making sure monthly deliverables do not get overlooked



You do not need to be an advanced SEO strategist, but you should be willing to learn our process and understand enough to manage the work effectively.



### Communicate With Clients



You will become one of the main points of contact for active client projects.



Communication may take place through:



*

* ClickUp

* Google Meet

* Internal team messages



You will be responsible for:



* Providing clear and proactive updates

* Asking clients for missing content, feedback, approvals, or access

* Explaining what is happening next

* Following up when a client has not responded

* Setting realistic expectations

* Keeping communication professional, organized, and easy to understand

* Making sure clients do not have to ask us repeatedly for updates



Clients should feel that their project is organized, actively managed, and moving forward.



### Communicate With the Team



You will communicate with our team throughout the workday, Monday through Friday.



This includes:



* Reviewing progress with team members

* Following up on tasks

* Answering project-related questions

* Clarifying priorities

* Identifying blockers

* Confirming deadlines

* Making sure team members understand what is expected

* Communicating important client feedback

* Helping the team determine what should be worked on next



You must be comfortable holding people accountable respectfully and directly.



### Own and Improve ClickUp



ClickUp is the primary project management system used by Frisco Web Agency.



You will be expected to:



* Keep ClickUp accurate and up to date

* Make sure tasks are assigned correctly

* Maintain deadlines, statuses, dependencies, and priorities

* Ensure task descriptions contain enough information for the work to be completed

* Keep client and internal communication organized

* Improve dashboards, templates, automations, and workflows

* Identify areas where ClickUp is becoming confusing or inefficient

* Recommend and implement improvements

* Make ClickUp a reliable source of truth for the entire company



At any time, we should be able to open ClickUp and quickly understand the status of every project.



### Maintain Company Playbooks



We use the Buy Back Your Time playbook method to document how work should be completed.



You will help:



* Create playbooks for repeatable processes

* Update playbooks when our processes change

* Organize instructions, videos, links, and resources

* Identify missing documentation

* Make sure team members follow the documented process

* Improve processes based on problems that occur during fulfillment



Our goal is to build a company that does not depend on information being stored only in one person’s head.



## What We Are Looking For



The right person for this role is:



* Highly organized

* Proactive

* Dependable

* Detail-oriented

* Comfortable following up with people

* Able to communicate professionally with clients

* Able to manage several projects at the same time

* Calm when priorities change

* Willing to take ownership of outcomes

* Able to think several steps ahead

* Comfortable asking questions when something is unclear

* Able to make decisions without needing constant approval

* Interested in improving systems and processes

* Consistent with communication

* Able to identify potential delays before deadlines are missed



You should naturally notice when something has not been completed and take action without waiting to be reminded.



## This Role Is Not a Good Fit If You:



* Wait for someone to tell you every next step

* Avoid difficult conversations or follow-ups

* Regularly forget details

* Are uncomfortable holding others accountable

* Only update ClickUp when someone reminds you

* Become overwhelmed when managing several projects

* Disappear during your working hours

* Allow unanswered questions to sit unresolved

* Assume that someone else will take responsibility

* Communicate vaguely or leave people uncertain

* Prefer completing isolated tasks instead of owning the overall outcome



## Required Qualifications



* Previous experience in project management, operations, or client coordination

* Experience using ClickUp or a similar project management platform

* Strong written and spoken English

* Strong organizational and time-management skills

* Experience communicating with clients through
 and meetings

* Reliable computer and internet connection

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to manage multiple deadlines and projects

* Ability to document and improve processes

* Willingness to learn website development and SEO fulfillment processes



Experience working for a web design, marketing, SEO, or digital agency is strongly preferred.



## Working Hours and Availability



This is a full-time position requiring 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday.



You must be available for a daily meeting with Christopher at:



**8:00 a.m. Central Time, Monday through Friday**



Because this is a communication-heavy role, you must also be responsive and available during your agreed working hours. Your working schedule will be established so that you have enough overlap with Christopher, the team, and our clients.



This is not a position where you can complete all your work without communicating with the team. Active communication throughout the workweek is an essential part of the job.



## Trial Period and Payment



This position will begin with a 90-day trial period.



During the trial period, we will evaluate:



* Reliability

* Communication

* Organization

* Ownership

* Ability to manage deadlines

* ClickUp management

* Client communication

* Team coordination

* Ability to keep projects moving

* Overall fit with the company



You will be paid every two weeks. You will complete each two-week work period and then receive payment for that completed period.



**Starting compensation: [INSERT MONTHLY SALARY OR HOURLY RATE]**



There is room for increased responsibility, compensation, and long-term growth as Frisco Web Agency grows.



## What Success Looks Like



You will be successful in this role when:



* Christopher no longer has to personally manage every project

* Every project has a clear status, owner, deadline, and next step

* Team members know what they should be working on

* Clients receive proactive communication

* Delays are identified and addressed early

* ClickUp is consistently accurate

* Tasks do not disappear or remain forgotten

* Projects are completed on time or ahead of schedule

* Company processes are documented and continuously improved

* You can clearly explain the status of every active project without confusion or uncertainty



The long-term goal is for you to fully own project fulfillment so Christopher can focus on marketing, sales, leadership, and growing the business.



## How to Apply



Please include the following information in your application:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your previous project management experience

3. Your experience using ClickUp

4. Any experience managing website or SEO projects

5. An example of a project that was falling behind and how you moved it forward

6. Your approach to following up with a team member who repeatedly misses deadlines

7. Your internet speed and computer specifications

8. Confirmation that you can attend a daily meeting at 8:00 a.m. Central Time

9. Your expected monthly salary

10. A short video introduction explaining why you believe you would be a strong fit for this position



At the beginning of your application, include the words:



**“I push projects forward.”**



Applications that do not include this phrase will not be considered.

title: Full-Time Content Creator & Real Estate Virtual Assistant
description:
Type: Full-Time (40 hours/week) - Long-Term - Remote

Location: Fully remote. We welcome applicants based in Philippines/Southeast Asia, Latin America, and Eastern Europe.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are a growing real estate and coliving business in Washington State looking for a creative-minded, content-first Virtual Assistant who will also help build the backbone of our operations. A big part of this role is documenting how we do things and turning messy, ad-hoc processes into clean, repeatable SOPs as we scale.



The most important thing we're hiring for is a genuine eye for content - the instinct for what makes a Reel or TikTok worth watching, how to cut a hook, and how to make a brand look sharp. That skill is hard to teach. Everything operational - property management, transaction coordination, MLS, bookkeeping - we will train you on, and you'll help us build the SOPs that make it all repeatable.



You'll start with content and SOP-building as your core focus and steadily take on operations as you ramp.



PROCESS & SOP DEVELOPMENT (Core Part of This Role)

- Document our workflows and turn repeatable tasks into clear, step-by-step SOPs

- Build checklists, templates, and process guides the whole team can follow

- Create screen-recorded/video SOPs and written guides for content, leasing, and operations tasks

- Maintain and organize a central SOP library, keeping documents current as processes change

- Continuously spot inefficiencies and propose better systems

- Help standardize how we onboard and train future team members



SOCIAL MEDIA & CONTENT CREATION (Primary Focus)

- Edit short-form vertical video (Instagram Reels, TikTok) from raw footage we provide - trimming, captions, b-roll, music sync, transitions, and strong hooks using CapCut

- Design graphics, carousels, thumbnails, and flyers using Canva, maintaining a consistent brand look

- Repurpose long-form footage, walkthroughs, and listing tours into multiple short clips

- Draft scroll-stopping captions and relevant hashtags

- Schedule and publish posts on a consistent cadence across our real estate and coliving brands

- Track basic performance (views, saves, follows, watch-through) and lean into what's working

- Ensure all listing advertising uses fair-housing-compliant language (training provided)



REAL ESTATE, LEASING & OPERATIONS (Will Train)

- Assist with transaction coordination - tracking deadlines, documents, signatures, and compliance items

- Pull and organize MLS data; assist with listing inputs and updates

- Respond to tenant and prospective tenant inquiries via phone,
, and messaging

- Conduct phone screenings and evaluate applicant fit for coliving environments

- Manage rental listings and operate property management software; track maintenance and vendor communication

- Assist with rent monitoring, bookkeeping, reconciliation, and basic financial reporting

- Occasional acquisitions support: call PropStream-style lists to identify and qualify off-market sellers



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- A demonstrated eye for short-form content - hooks, pacing, and what makes vertical video perform

- Proficiency in CapCut and Canva

- A portfolio or samples of short-form videos you've edited (required to be considered)

- Strong written and spoken English - professional, clear, confident communication

- A natural documenter who loves creating order from chaos and builds SOPs while learning each task

- Comfortable and confident speaking on the phone with tenants, prospective tenants, and cleaners

- Spanish highly preferred (written and spoken)

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, self-directed, coachable, and reliable internet



NICE TO HAVE (Not Required)

- Real estate, property management, leasing, or coliving experience (PadSplit a plus)

- Familiarity with MLS and transaction coordination

- Property management platforms (Innago, TurboTenant, RentRedi, AppFolio), QuickBooks, PropStream, CRMs (GoHighLevel, Follow Up Boss)



SCHEDULE, COMPENSATION & GROWTH

- Full-time, approximately 40 hours per week, long-term

- Flexible scheduling with required availability during U.S. business hours (Pacific Time preferred)

- Compensation: $5-8/hr

- A long-term, stable role with leadership opportunities as the portfolio and brand grow



TO APPLY: Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph and include a link to a portfolio or samples of short-form videos you've edited, plus a brief note on your relevant experience.

title: Amazon Product Development and Sourcing Specialist | China Negotiation | 3+ Years PL Experience
description:
Who We Are

BTS Brands is an 8-year-old private label company selling across US, CA, UK, EU, AU, JP and expanding into Saudi Arabia. We operate across two brands - one in the travel accessories category and one in beauty devices - with 52+ active SKUs.



We're not a startup figuring things out - we have systems, a team, and a clear direction. What we need now is someone senior who can take full ownership of product development for one of our brands while we scale.



The Role

This is not a VA role. This is a specialist position for someone who has done this before and can work independently.

You will own the full product lifecycle for one brand: from identifying opportunities, to negotiating with Chinese suppliers on WeChat, to making sure samples, timelines, packaging, and user manuals are all on track before launch. You'll also do product research for our second brand.

You'll work closely with our marketing and design team, and report directly to the owner.



What You'll Do Daily:

- Conduct product research across Amazon marketplaces (US/CA/UK/EU/AU/JP)

- Analyze competition, demand, pricing, and profitability (ROI, FBA fees, net margin)

- Communicate directly with Chinese suppliers via WeChat - negotiate pricing, MOQs, timelines

- Request and evaluate samples, coordinate quality checks

- Monitor production timelines and flag delays before they become problems

- Review packaging and user manuals for compliance (not copy, just accuracy)

- Calculate profitability at every stage before committing to a launch

- Collaborate with marketing and graphic design teams on launch prep

- Report weekly with recommendations and progress updates



Tools You Must Know:

- Helium 10 (Cerebro, Black Box, Xray, Keyword Tracker)

- Keepa - price history, trends, seasonality

- Amazon Seller Central - BSR, sales data interpretation

- Alibaba + WeChat - supplier sourcing and negotiation

- Google Sheets / Excel - ROI models, dashboards, profitability trackers

- Jungle Scout - a plus



Who We're Looking For:

- 3–5 years experience in Amazon Private Label product development and sourcing

- You've negotiated directly with Chinese suppliers - not just browsed Alibaba

- You think in numbers: margins, costs, lead times, risks

- You communicate clearly in English, written and verbal

- You're organized and proactive - you chase timelines, you don't wait to be chased

- You want a long-term role with room to grow, not a short contract



Compensation & Setup:

- $1,000–$1,400/month based on experience

- Full-time, 40h/week

- 14 days paid leave after 3 months

- First 3 months: time-tracked via Time Doctor (removed after we establish trust)

- Long-term position - We Invest in People Who Invest in Us



Important

This role is for one of our brands that currently has no team. You'll be building from the ground up with clear direction from ownership. If you need someone to micromanage your daily tasks, this isn't the right fit. If you thrive with clear objectives and autonomy, keep reading.





To Apply - Required

Answer these 4 questions. Applications without answers will not be considered:



1. Describe a product you sourced from a Chinese supplier, how did you find them, how did you negotiate, and what was the final outcome? Include the platform you used to find them (Alibaba, WeChat, trade show etc.), the MOQ you negotiated, and one specific thing that almost went wrong. Do not describe what you would do - describe what you actually did.

2. Walk me through your evaluation process for a Private Label product - what metrics matter most to you, what makes you say no, and what makes you say yes? Give a real example without naming the product. What's your process, not your tools.

3. What tools do you use daily for Amazon product research, and rate your confidence in each from 1 to 10. For the tool you rated highest - walk me through one specific thing you do in it that most people skip or don't know about.

4. What's the biggest mistake you've seen (or made) in product development, and what did you change after? Be specific.

title: US Company Hiring: Senior GEO + Branded-Search Specialist (Skincare, Shopify) - Long Term
description:
We're a US consulting team working with an established US skincare brand on Shopify. We're hiring ONE senior person to own two things: 



1) Get the brand cited and recommended inside AI answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity,

   Gemini, Google AI Overviews).



2) Make the brand's branded Google results look great, so when someone searches

   the brand name or "[brand] reviews," what they find is positive, accurate,

   and brand-controlled.



Long-term and full-time, not project work. You'll report to our strategy lead, but we want a real thinking partner with a point of view: look at the data, bring ideas, tell us when we're wrong. A brain with hands, not a ticket-taker.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Pillar 1 - Get us cited in AI / LLMs (GEO):

- Get the brand accurately described, cited, and recommended across ChatGPT,

  Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews.

- Build entity consistency across the web, structure content for extraction, and

  earn citations from the sources each AI platform trusts (Wikipedia, Reddit,

  authoritative listicles, etc.).

- Track brand mentions, citations, and sentiment across the AI platforms and

  report on it.

Pillar 2 - Make our branded Google search look great (reputation / ORM):

- Own page one for branded and review-intent queries (brand name, "[brand]

  reviews," "is [brand] legit," product names) with positive, brand-controlled

  results.

- Get review/star ratings showing in results via Product/Review schema, and

  reduce the prominence of negative results.

- Claim and clean up the Google Business Profile and the brand knowledge panel.

The foundation that powers both:

- On-page and technical SEO on Shopify (titles, meta, headings, internal linking).

- Schema markup (Product, Review/AggregateRating, FAQ, Organization).

- Content: briefs, drafting, and editing in clean English, built to get cited by

  AI and to own branded results. Health-adjacent beauty content, so accuracy matters.



YOU MUST HAVE



- Real, demonstrable GEO / AI-search experience: getting brands mentioned or

  cited in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, or Google AI Overviews. This is central

  and we will test it, not just take your word for it.

- Experience controlling branded / reputation search results on Google (branded

  SERP, review schema, Google Business Profile, knowledge panel).

- 4+ years hands-on SEO, with strong Shopify on-page and schema experience.

- Excellent written English. We'll judge this from your application.

- Comfort using AI tools to work faster, with human editing. Quality over volume.

- The ability to think, not just execute. Opinions welcome.

NICE TO HAVE



- DTC / e-commerce or beauty/skincare experience.

- Digital PR, link building, or Reddit/community experience.

- Familiarity with E-E-A-T and YMYL content standards.



PAY: PHP 85,
,000/month full-time, with room above for the right person.

Paid on a set monthly date. 13th-month and a paid trial period included.



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully - we ignore generic applications)



1. Start your reply with the word "ORCHID" so we know you read this.

2. In 4-5 sentences: when someone asks ChatGPT or Perplexity to recommend a

   product, how does the AI d
 which brands to name, and what are two

   specific things you'd do to get our skincare brand cited? Be specific.

   This is the answer we weight the most.

3. Send 2 links: one branded-search / reputation or technical SEO project, and

   one piece of content you wrote.

4. Tell us your full-time monthly rate and your timezone overlap with US Pacific.

We reply to everyone who follows all 4 steps. Final hire is after a short paid

trial task covering both pillars: improving our branded Google results, and

getting us cited in AI.

title: Education and Training Administrator
description:
Position Overview

The Education and Training Administrator is responsible for providing comprehensive

administrative, operational, and coordination support to the Education and Training Manager

across the IntegrityX Group.

The primary purpose of this role is to increase the operational capacity of the Education and

Training Manager by assuming responsibility for routine administrative, operational, and

coordination activities that support the effective management of the Education and Training

Department.

The role supports the efficient operation of the Education and Training Department across

multiple business units by ensuring that administrative processes are completed accurately,

documentation is maintained, projects remain organised, and routine operational activities are

coordinated effectively.

Working closely with the Education and Training Manager, the Training Development Officer,

and the Education and Training Officers, the Education and Training Administrator provides

operational support across departmental initiatives while ensuring that administrative processes

are delivered efficiently and consistently.

An understanding of educational environments, training operations, and learning administration

is highly beneficial to ensure effective support across the Education and Training Department.

The Education and Training Administrator does not perform instructional design, educational

delivery, tutoring, Training Needs Analysis, or management functions, but provides the

administrative support necessary for the Education and Training Manager, Training

Development Officer, and Education and Training Officers to operate efficiently.



Key Responsibilities

1. Executive and Departmental Management Support

Provide day-to-day administrative support to the Education and Training Manager.

Coordinate departmental administrative activities across multiple business units.

Prepare reports, presentations, trackers, and supporting documentation required by the

Education and Training Manager.

Maintain departmental action registers, project trackers, and operational records.

Monitor deadlines, outstanding actions, and follow-up requirements.

Coordinate administrative tasks arising from management meetings and strategic

initiatives.

Maintain departmental templates, forms, registers, and operational documentation.

Assist with the coordination of departmental projects and initiatives.

Maintain confidentiality of all departmental information and records.



2. Meeting Administration and Executive Reporting

Prepare agendas, meeting documentation, and presentation material for meetings

hosted by the Education and Training Manager.

Update management presentation slide decks using information supplied by the

Education and Training Manager.

Produce executive summaries fro
eting transcripts.

Compile action lists and extract key directives assigned to the Education and Training

Manager.

Maintain meeting action registers and monitor outstanding actions.

Coordinate meeting schedules, invitations, and follow-up communication.

Assist with the preparation of monthly and weekly departmental reporting.

Maintain accurate records of decisions, actions, and meeting outcomes.



3. Training Administration and Learning Management

System (LMS) Support

Administer training activities within Tekmatix and other approved Learning Management

Systems.

Upload training materials, videos, lesson resources, assessments, and supporting

documentation as directed.

Maintain course structures and learning resources within the LMS.

Enrol learners into training programmes as instructed by the Education and Training

Manager.

Allocate appropriate training programmes to employees across the IntegrityX Group.

Maintain learner records and training completion data.

Coordinate certification administration and maintain certificate records.

Support training implementation through accurate administration and system

maintenance.

Maintain training development trackers and administrative records.



4. Employee Onboarding and Training Coordination

Coordinate onboarding administration for new employees.

Create learner profiles and training records within approved systems.

Allocate onboarding and role-specific training programmes.

Schedule welcome meetings between new employees and the Education and Training

Manager.

Send onboarding communications and training information on behalf of the Education

and Training Manager.

Monitor onboarding progress and training completion.

Maintain onboarding trackers and escalate outstanding actions where required.

Support onboarding administration across all IntegrityX Group business units.



5. Smart Workforce Academy Administration

Coordinate administrative activities relating to Academy learners.

Respond to routine learner enquiries using approved information and templates.

Monitor learner progress through administrative tracking.

Maintain learner records and certification registers.

Confirm completion of automated learner communication processes.

Support alumni administration and routine follow-up activities.

Escalate educational, commercial, or management enquiries to the Education and

Training Manager where appropriate.



6. Education Administration and Project Logistics

Provide administrative support for education-related projects as directed by the

Education and Training Manager.

Support preparation of management documentation for education meetings.

Update administrative sections of education project documentation under the direction of

the Education and Training Manager.

Coordinate logistical requirements for approved learner activities, educational

programmes, and departmental projects.

Research suppliers and obtain quotations for approved educational resources,

stationery, equipment, and learning materials.

Prepare procurement information for purchasing by the appropriate personnel.

Coordinate logistical requirements associated with approved educational events and

activities.

Maintain administrative records relating to departmental education projects.



7. Documentation, Records and Operational

Administration

Maintain organised electronic filing systems and document repositories.

Apply approved naming conventions and version control procedures.

Maintain departmental trackers, registers, calendars, and operational records.

Perform administrative quality checks on documentation and records.

Monitor document completeness and identify missing or outdated information.

Maintain departmental templates and standard documentation.

Ensure accurate record keeping across departmental systems.

Support audit readiness through organised documentation management.



8. Stakeholder Communication and Project Coordination

Coordinate routine communication between internal stakeholders, learners, and external

service providers.

Send reminders, follow-ups, confirmations, and administrative correspondence on behalf

of the Education and Training Manager.

Coordinate project administration across departmental initiatives.

Monitor project milestones and follow up on outstanding deliverables.

Maintain communication records and project documentation.

Escalate matters requiring managerial judgement to the Education and Training

Manager.



9. Personal Learning and Internal Compliance

Maintain knowledge of IntegrityX Group systems, policies, SOPs, and administrative

procedures.

Participate in departmental meetings and training activities.

Develop proficiency in approved digital platforms, Learning Management Systems, and

AI-supported administrative tools.

Maintain high standards of professionalism, confidentiality, and organisational

excellence.

Continuously identify opportunities to improve administrative efficiency within the

Education and Training Department.

Required Skills and Attributes



Qualifications

A recognised Certificate, Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration,

Office Administration, Education, Training, Project Administration, or a related field is

preferred.

A qualification or recognised certification in Office Administration, Executive

Administration, Project Administration, Business Administration, or a related

administrative discipline will be advantageous.

A teaching qualification, tutoring experience, or an educational background will be

considered advantageous due to the nature of the department and the support provided

across education and training initiatives.



Experience

Previous experience in an administrative, executive support, project coordination,

training administration, or education administration role.

Experience working within a Learning Management System (preferably Tekmatix) or

similar online learning platforms will be advantageous.

Experience supporting multiple stakeholders and coordinating projects within a

fast-paced environment.

Experience working remotely within an international organisation will be advantageous.



Skills and Attributes

Excellent organisational and administrative skills.

Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

Strong time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet

deadlines.

High level of proficiency in Google Workspace and Microsoft Office applications.

Experience using Learning Management Systems (preferably Tekmatix) is

advantageous.

Strong administrative coordination and project management skills.

Ability to work independently in a remote environment while supporting multiple

stakeholders.

Strong problem-solving and organisational skills.

Professional, proactive, and service-oriented approach.

Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound administrative judgement.

Willingness to learn and utilise AI-supported administrative tools and emerging

technologies to improve operational efficiency.

Ability to support an executive-level manager through effective planning, organisation,

coordination, and follow-up.

title: Full-Time Growth & Marketing Specialist
description:
Job Title: Full-Time Growth & Marketing Specialist

Company: Quiresoft Technologies Inc. 

Location: Remote (Philippines-based), working full-time on PST (Pacific Standard Time) hours

Type: Full-time, long-term, exclusive (no other clients or side engagements)



About Us

Quiresoft Technologies Inc. is a web design and digital marketing agency based in Langley, BC, serving clients across Metro Vancouver. We operate a portfolio of brands spanning agency services, real estate personal branding, and tech startups. We are looking for one exceptional, do-it-all growth person to become the engine behind all of them.

This is not a single-task role. We want a startup growth operator who can wear many hats, take ownership, and help us build and scale multiple businesses at once.



What You'll Do

You will own and execute growth across our businesses, including:

- Social media advertising: Plan, build, launch, and optimize paid campaigns on Meta 
/Instagram) and other platforms. - Manage budgets, audiences, creative testing, and reporting against ROAS targets.

-
 marketing: Build and run end-to-end
 campaigns that generate real leads and conversions. Write copy, design sequences, segment lists, set up automations, and report on open/click/conversion performance.

- Cold calling: Make outbound calls to prospects with confidence and professionalism. This requires an excellent English accent and communication skills, since you'll be speaking directly with North American business owners and clients.

- CRM management: Build and manage pipelines, automations, and workflows in HighLevel (GoHighLevel). Keep our lead flow organized and our follow-up tight.

- Startup growth: Help build and grow our startups (like QuickLinq) from the ground up. Develop go-to-market ideas, run experiments, find growth channels, and execute relentlessly.

- Brand building: Support the development of the Mani Garcha real estate personal brand, including content, outreach, and lead generation.

-General growth ownership: Treat our businesses like your own. Identify opportunities, propose strategies, and execute without needing to be micromanaged.



What We're Looking For

- Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in digital marketing, growth, or startup operations.

- Proven, hands-on experience generating leads through
 marketing (not just theory, real results).

- Direct experience running paid ads on Meta with measurable outcomes.

- Hands-on experience with HighLevel CRM.

- Excellent spoken English with a clear, professional accent suitable for cold calling North American prospects.

- Strong written English for
 copy and client communication.

- Ability to work independently, manage multiple businesses, and take full ownership.

- Available full-time on PST hours, long-term, working exclusively for us.



Preferred (Big Plus)

- Experience working with North American realtors or in the real estate industry.

- Experience supporting or growing early-stage startups.

- Familiarity with digital agency workflows.



Who You Are

You're a self-starter who thrives on building things. You don't wait to be told what to do, you spot what needs doing and do it. You're comfortable juggling several brands at once, you communicate clearly, and you're in this for the long haul. You want to grow with us, not bounce to the next gig.



The Role Offers

A long-term, stable, full-time position with one company.

The chance to own growth across multiple businesses and genuinely shape their direction.

Direct work with the founder and real decision-making input.

Room to grow as our businesses grow.



To Apply

Send your resume along with a short note covering: the lead-generation results you've driven through
 marketing, the Meta ad campaigns you've run (with rough numbers), your experience with HighLevel, and any real estate or startup experience. Please include a short voice recording or be ready to do a quick call so we can hear your spoken English.

title: Amazon Catalog Manager & Troubleshooting Expert
description:
Mission

Keep every client catalog on Amazon running at 100%. Listings accurate, issues resolved fast, inventory flowing, and account health green. You are the operational backbone that ensures nothing falls through the cracks so the strategy team can focus on growth.



Outcomes



1. Catalog Accuracy & Listing Management

- Zero listing errors on live client accounts (pricing, images, descriptions, specifications always current and correct)

- All new listings and catalog updates published within 24 hours of receiving approved content

- Flat file uploads executed error-free (or resolved independently)

- SEO-optimized listing copy (titles, bullet points, descriptions, backend search terms) created for all new and updated listings using our AI-powered Claude workflow

- Catalog aligned with Amazon Rufus optimization requirements across all managed accounts



2. Troubleshooting & Issue Resolution

- All open Amazon cases responded to within 24 hours, resolved within 72 hours (or escalated with documented reason)

- Listing suppressions identified and resolved within 24 hours

- Account Health rating maintained at "Good" or above

- FBA inventory discrepancies flagged and reimbursement claims filed within 48 hours of detection with the help of TrueOps

- Zero policy violations caused by catalog errors



3. Inventory Monitoring & Reshipment Support

- Stockout and overstock risks flagged to the Amazon Lead before they become problems

- Bi-Weekly reshipment plans completed on time using our tools (estimated 15 minutes per plan)

- Zero preventable stockouts on any managed account



4. AI Adoption & Process Innovation

- Fully adopt and operate our AI-powered Claude workflows for SEO listing creation, reshipment planning, and other automated tasks

- Proactively identify at least 1 new automation or AI opportunity per month. Tasks you do repeatedly that could be streamlined

- All repeatable workflows documented in SOPs (90% coverage by end of your first quarter)

- Weekly status update delivered to the Amazon Lead covering: open cases, listing changes, inventory flags, and blockers

- Respond to team Slack messages within 4 business hours during working hours



Competencies

- Attention to Detail: Every listing element — every bullet point, every image, every price — is checked and correct before going live. You catch the small things before they become big problems.

- Speed & Reliability: Tasks get done on time, every time. You don't drop balls. When you say something will be done by Tuesday, it's done by Tuesday.

- Resourcefulness with Amazon: You know how to navigate Seller Central, open the right cases, find the right category, and -push through Amazon's bureaucracy without needing hand-holding.

- Follow-Through: You see every task and case through to resolution. Nothing sits in "pending" forgotten. You track what's open and close it.

- Calm Under Pressure: When a listing gets suppressed or an account health alert fires, you stay level-headed, diagnose the problem, and fix it. No drama.

- AI-Curious & Growth-Minded: You're genuinely interested in AI tools and automation. You don't just use the workflows we hand you. You ask "what else could we automate?" and actively look for ways to work smarter.



Why Work Here

- Trusted Like an Adult: Work from where you want and when you're most productive, not 9-5 for appearances. Own your outcomes without micromanagement.

- Constantly Challenged: We challenge everybody to be 1?tter every day by doing work that moves the needle, not busywork.

- Radically Honest Environment: Direct feedback that helps you improve. Zero corporate doubletalk.

- Speed Over Bureaucracy: Fast decisions without approval layers. Your impact is visible and recognized.

- High-Caliber Team: Work alongside A-players who take ownership. Everybody in the team wants you to win.

- AI-Powered Workflow: We run automated Claude workflows for SEO, reshipment planning, and more. You'll work with tools most agencies don't even know exist — and you'll help us build the next ones.



Our team said it best: "I believe the company will achieve its long-term goals, and I want to be there when that happens."



Requirements

- 2+ years in e-commerce operations and Seller Central

- Proven experience with Inventory Flat Files (creation, editing, bulk uploads)

- Working knowledge of Amazon case management and policy compliance

- Understanding of SEO and keyword optimization for Amazon listings

- Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar). You don't need to be an expert, but you should be genuinely interested in learning and adopting AI-powered workflows

- Fluent English communication

- Reliable internet





This Role Is Not For You If You…

- Prefer strategic planning over hands-on execution

- Get bored by detail-oriented, repetitive work

- Need someone to check on you to stay on track

- Are uncomfortable working in Amazon Seller Central daily

- Want a role where you set the strategy rather than execute it



Hiring Process

  * Text campaign performance

title: Regulatory Affairs & Trademark Specialist – Cosmetics & Personal Care
description:
UAS Pharmaceuticals is an Australian derma-cosmetic company with a growing international presence across skincare, personal care, sun care and therapeutic cosmetic categories. Our brands include Neutriderm, Dermavive, Dermqure, Sunstop and Sunvive. 



We are looking for a highly organised and experienced Regulatory Affairs & Trademark Specialist to support our global regulatory activities and manage our trademark portfolio more cost-effectively. 



This role has two main responsibilities: 



First, you will support our current Regulatory Lead with cosmetic and personal care regulatory work across different countries. This includes product registrations, regulatory documents, ingredient checks, label reviews, claims checks, artwork compliance, technical files, SDS, GMP documents, certificates and registration trackers. 



Second, you will manage our trademark portfolio. We currently use external trademark lawyers for too many routine tasks, and the cost has become too high. We need someone who can handle trademark searches, applications, renewals, deadline tracking, document preparation and portfolio management internally. Trademark lawyers will only be used when necessary for complex disputes, objections or legal issues. 



Main tasks: 



Manage trademark searches, applications, renewals and deadline tracking.  



Maintain a complete trademark tracker by brand, country, class, filing date, renewal date and status.  



Prepare trademark documents and coordinate with external lawyers only when needed.  



Monitor trademark conflicts, similar marks and renewal deadlines.  



Support cosmetic regulatory registrations and renewals.  



Prepare and organise regulatory documents, dossiers, SDS, GMP certificates and technical files.  



Review product labels, packaging, ingredients and marketing claims for compliance.  



Monitor cosmetic regulatory requirements across ASEAN, Australia, New Zealand, India, Middle East, EU, UK, USA and other export markets.  



Maintain regulatory trackers and document folders.  



Follow up with distributors, consultants, authorities, suppliers and internal teams.  



Provide clear updates on pending, urgent and overdue items.  



Requirements: 



Experience in cosmetics, skincare, personal care, pharmaceutical, nutraceutical or FMCG regulatory affairs.  



Experience with trademark applications, renewals and trademark portfolio tracking.  



Strong English writing skills.  



Excellent attention to detail.  



Strong spreadsheet and document management skills.  



Able to work independently from home.  



Able to research requirements and summarise them clearly.  



Must be proactive, organised and deadline-focused.  



Must be based in the Philippines.  



Must be available full-time, 8 hours per day, Monday to Friday.  



Must accept USD 12 per hour.  



Preferred: 



Experience with ASEAN cosmetic regulations.  



Experience using WIPO, USPTO, IP Australia, EUIPO, UKIPO or other trademark databases.  



Pharmacy, science, legal or paralegal background.  



Experience working with international product registrations.

title: Automotive Vehicle Acquisition Specialist | Inbound Seller Lead Closer
description:
Automotive Vehicle Acquisition Specialist / Inbound Seller Lead Closer



Remote | Philippines-Based | Full-Time



$7.25 – $9.25 USD/hour + Performance Bonuses | Paid in USD (Exchanged to PHP)



Do you love cars? Do you understand how to talk to vehicle owners, qualify their car, negotiate professionally, and help a dealership acquire inventory from motivated sellers?



We are hiring an Automotive Vehicle Acquisition Specialist on behalf of a U.S.-based dealership team. This role is focused on working with inbound seller leads from people who have expressed interest in selling their vehicle.



You will be responsible for contacting vehicle owners, gathering accurate vehicle details, understanding seller motivation, coordinating offers, negotiating professionally, and helping the dealership purchase more cars every month.



This is not a basic appointment-setting role. This is a specialized automotive acquisition and closing role.



We want someone who is confident on the phone, loves cars, understands the auto industry, and has experience working with U.S. automotive customers, dealerships, vehicle buying, BDC, sales, or lead follow-up.



WHAT YOU’LL DO:



Inbound Seller Lead Follow-Up



* Contact inbound vehicle seller leads generated through Meta Ads and other lead sources



* Respond quickly to interested sellers by phone, SMS,
, or CRM follow-up



* Follow up consistently with sellers who do not answer immediately



* Build trust quickly and create a professional buying experience for the seller



* Keep sellers engaged through the full vehicle acquisition process



* Work a high-volume pipeline of interested vehicle owners each month



Vehicle Qualification



* Gather key vehicle information, including year, make, model, trim, mileage, VIN, condition, options, title status, payoff status, and seller timeline



* Ask the right questions to understand why the seller wants to sell



* Identify whether the vehicle fits the dealership’s acquisition criteria



* Request photos, documents, payoff information, and any additional details needed by the dealership



* Spot red flags such as title issues, major damage, incorrect vehicle details, unrealistic seller expectations, or incomplete information



Negotiation & Seller Closing



* Communicate dealership-approved offers clearly and professionally



* Negotiate with sellers while protecting dealership margin and acquisition goals



* Handle common seller objections around price, timing, payoff, competing offers, trade-in value, and convenience



* Help sellers understand the value of selling directly to the dealership



* Create urgency and move qualified sellers toward the next step



* Work toward a monthly goal of helping the dealership acquire 30+ vehicles once fully ramped



Appointment & Handoff Coordination



* Schedule appraisal appointments, vehicle drop-offs, or dealership handoffs when needed



* Coordinate with dealership managers, buyers, sales teams, or local staff for final review and purchase approval



* Make sure the seller knows exactly what to bring, where to go, and what to expect



* Confirm appointments and reduce no-shows through strong follow-up



* Help ensure the dealership has all necessary information before the seller arrives



CRM & Pipeline Management



* Accurately update every lead in the CRM



* Log call outcomes, seller notes, vehicle details, offer status, objections, follow-up dates, and next steps



* Move leads through the correct pipeline stages



* Keep the acquisition pipeline clean, organized, and up to date



* Track seller status from new lead to contacted, qualified, offer made, appointment set, purchased, lost, or follow-up needed



* Maintain strong documentation so the dealership team can act quickly



Performance & Accountability



* Track daily calls, conversations, follow-ups, qualified sellers, offers, appointments, and purchased vehicles



* Prioritize the highest-quality opportunities first



* Follow up aggressively without being pushy or unprofessional



* Review performance and improve call handling, negotiation, follow-up, and close rate



* Communicate trends in seller feedback, pricing objections, market conditions, and lead quality



* Bring solutions and recommendations to improve acquisition performance



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



* Minimum 2 years of sales, appointment setting, BDC, automotive, dealership, or outbound/inbound lead follow-up experience



* Strong interest in cars and the automotive industry



* Experience working with U.S. customers or U.S.-based businesses



* Experience in the auto industry is strongly preferred



* Experience with vehicle buying, dealership BDC, automotive sales, trade-in leads, private-party sellers, or vehicle acquisition is highly preferred



* Strong spoken English with a clear, confident, professional phone voice



* Ability to build trust quickly with vehicle owners



* Strong negotiation and objection-handling skills



* Ability to stay organized while managing a high-volume lead pipeline



* Strong attention to detail when collecting vehicle information



* Comfortable asking direct questions about vehicle condition, payoff, title, price expectations, and seller motivation



* Comfortable working toward monthly acquisition goals



* Reliable, competitive, coachable, and consistent



* Ability to follow scripts while still sounding natural and human



* Reliable home office setup with stable internet, backup internet, quality headset, and quiet work environment



* Ability to work Monday-Friday 9 am - 5 pm Pacific Standard Time (12 am-8 am Manila Time)



NICE TO HAVE:



* Direct experience buying vehicles for a dealership



* Experience with U.S. vehicle acquisition, automotive BDC, used car buying, trade-in leads, or private-party seller follow-up



* Experience working with U.S. dealerships



* Experience using automotive CRMs, GoHighLevel, DealerSocket, VinSolutions, Elead, HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar platforms



* Experience with KBB, Carfax, AutoCheck, vAuto, vehicle appraisal tools, or dealership inventory tools



* Experience handling seller objections around payoff, title, condition, price, and competing offers



* Experience with inbound Meta Ads leads or other paid lead sources



* Experience with SMS follow-up and appointment confirmation



* Experience creating Loom videos, written updates, or clear notes for internal teams



* Strong understanding of U.S. vehicle makes, models, trims, mileage, condition, and resale value factors



WHAT’S INCLUDED:



* $7.25–$9.25 USD/hour, paid in USD



* Approx. 75,000 – 98,000 PHP/month full-time, depending on exchange rate and final hourly rate



* Performance bonuses available based on vehicle acquisition results, seller follow-up quality, appointment quality, and overall performance



* Fully remote, full-time position



* Full HMO benefits after 90 days of employment



* Clear growth path into Senior Vehicle Acquisition Specialist, Automotive BDC Lead, Acquisition Team Lead, or Campaign Manager role



* Work with a U.S.-based dealership team focused on acquiring more vehicles from interested sellers



HOW TO APPLY:



Send your resume and a short note, 3-5 sentences, describing your automotive, sales, dealership, BDC, or vehicle-buying experience.



Please include:



1. Your experience working in the automotive industry

2. Whether you have worked with U.S. dealerships or U.S. automotive customers

3. Whether you have experience buying vehicles, handling trade-in leads, or speaking with private-party sellers

4. Your experience negotiating with customers or sellers

5. Your experience using CRMs, dialers, or dealership software

6. A short voice recording or Loom video introducing yourself and explaining why you would be strong in a vehicle acquisition role



Applications without a clear explanation of automotive or sales experience will not be reviewed.



This position is placed through RevStone, a staffing and operations company supporting U.S.-based businesses.

title: Hostality / Operations Manager
description:
Operations & Hospitality Manager



Company: Stay'ca Property Management

Location: Remote / Virtual

Type: Full-time

Reports to: Owner / Founder

Direct report: Guest Communications Specialist





About Stay'ca



Stay'ca is a growing short-term rental management company operating a portfolio of roughly 50 properties across Mississippi, Alabama, and the Florida Gulf Coast. We pair genuine, warm hospitality with sharp operations — and we're building the systems and team to scale that without losing the personal touch our guests and owners count on.



We're looking for a senior operator to step into a role that touches nearly every part of the business. This is not a task-taker position. It's for someone who sees a messy process and instinctively wants to fix it, document it, and make it run without them.





The Role



As Operations & Hospitality Manager, you'll own the day-to-day operation of the guest experience and the systems behind it. You'll lead our guest communications, protect and grow our review scores, keep our listings and pricing performing, and build the repeatable processes that let us scale cleanly. You'll manage our Guest Communications Specialist and report directly to the owner.



The right person wears a lot of hats comfortably, learns new tools quickly on their own, and turns "we keep running into this problem" into a documented solution.





What You'll Own



Guest Communications & Retention





Lead the guest messaging operation and supervise our Guest Communications Specialist

Resolve escalations, recover at-risk stays, and turn problems into 5-star reviews

Own guest satisfaction and review-score performance across the portfolio





Revenue Management





Manage dynamic pricing strategy to maximize occupancy and revenue

Monitor market trends, competitor rates, and seasonal demand





Listing Optimization





Audit and improve listings — titles, descriptions, photos, and amenities — to boost conversion and ranking

Keep listing content accurate and competitive across platforms





Marketing & Social Media





Drive marketing efforts to grow direct bookings and brand presence

Plan and manage social media content and engagement

Canva to make graphics





Operations & Systems





Coordinate cleaning, maintenance requests, and vendor scheduling

Build, document, and refine SOPs and workflows so the business runs more smoothly as we grow

Identify operational gaps and design the systems to close them





Team Leadership





Manage and support tea
mbers, set clear expectations, and keep everyone rowing in the same direction







Who You Are



+ Experienced. You have a solid background in short-term rental, property management, or hospitality operations and understand how the pieces fit together.

+ A self-directed learner. You can pick up a new tool or platform on your own without hand-holding. We don't expect you to know every system on day one — we expect you to figure them out.

+ A problem solver. When something breaks or a process is inefficient, you diagnose it and fix it rather than working around it.

+ A systems builder. You think in repeatable processes and lasting solutions, not one-off patches.

+ Organized and reliable. You can juggle many responsibilities, prioritize what matters, and follow through.

+ A strong communicator. You write clearly and professionally, and you bring genuine warmth to guest interactions.

+ Comfortable working remotely. You're disciplined and accountable without someone looking over your shoulder.





Tools You'll Use



You don't need mastery of all of these, but familiarity is a plus and a willingness to learn them fast is essential:





+ OwnerRez (property management / PMS)

+ PriceLabs (dynamic pricing / revenue management)

+ AirDNA (market data and analytics)

+ Microsoft Word & Excel

+ Claude AI (we use AI tools heavily — comfort with them is a real advantage)

+ Zillow, Crexi and other market and listing platforms

+ Canva

+ GoHighLevel





If you're the kind of person who enjoys learning new software, you'll fit right in.





Logistics





Schedule: Full-time

Location: Fully remote

Compensation: Competitive and based on experience — discussed during the interview process





How to Apply



Tell us about yourself and why this role is a fit. We'd especially love to hear about a time you took a messy or inefficient process and built a better system around it.  Please send example of unhappy guest (what happened) and how you made it right. Please include your resume and any relevant short-term rental or hospitality experience.  Also please send a 2-3 min intro video introducing yourself.

title: Sales Agent - Full Cycle
description:
You will own the conversion layer between marketing and revenue.

Your job is to follow up with webinar registrants, attendees, leads, course prospects, and abandoned checkouts; identify serious buyers; handle objections; close sales; and document what prospects are actually saying so the marketing and offer improve over time.



You must be comfortable with direct selling. You must also have judgment. We are not interested in pressure tactics, fake urgency, or selling the wrong person into the wrong offer.



What You Will Own

Follow up with new leads, webinar registrants, attendees, no-shows, and checkout abandonments by phone, text,
, and CRM workflows.

Convert qualified prospects into paid webinar offers and courses

Run discovery calls that identify the prospect’s real goals, constraints, timeline, financial readiness, and decision barriers.

Handle common objections around price, timing, spouse or partner alignment, confidence, and “I need to think about it.”

Maintain fast response times and disciplined follow-up across every assigned lead.

Keep CRM records current, including call notes, disposition, next step, objections, and purchase likelihood.

Re-engage old leads intelligently rather than treating every prospect like a cold call.

Surface recurring objections, messaging gaps, broken funnel steps, and offer opportunities to the team each week.

Help improve scripts, follow-up sequences, webinar CTAs, and conversion systems based on real prospect feedback.

Represent AM with credibility, precision, urgency, and high standards.



What Success Looks Like

Within the first 30–60 days, you should be able to:



Respond to inbound leads quickly and consistently.

Build a reliable follow-up cadence for webinar leads and course prospects.

Produce clean CRM data the company can actually use.

Convert qualified conversations into measurable revenue.

Identify which leads are buyers, which need nurture, and which are simply consuming free content.

Improve close rates without damaging trust or brand positioning.

You Are Likely a Fit If You

Have experience in consultative sales, enrollment sales, education, coaching, financial services, real estate, high-ticket offers, or digital products.

Can sell with intelligence and conviction without sounding scripted or manipulative.

Are comfortable making calls, sending direct follow-up, and asking for the sale.

Know how to uncover the real objection instead of accepting the first excuse.

Are organized enough to run a pipeline without being chased.

Can write clearly and communicate professionally by phone, text,
, and video.

Understand that revenue is a result of disciplined follow-up, not “good vibes.”

Want a performance-driven role where your output is visible.



You Are Not a Fit If You

Need leads to close themselves.

Avoid phone calls or feel uncomfortable asking for payment.

Treat CRM updates as optional.

Rely on canned scripts without listening to the person in front of you.

Need constant direction to follow up, stay organized, or hit activity targets.

Want a passive customer-service role disguised as sales.



Preferred Experience

2+ years in sales, enrollment, business development, account executive, inside sales, or high-touch customer conversion roles.

Experience selling courses, education, coaching, real estate products, financial services, or premium digital offers is a strong advantage.

Experience with HighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, Close, or similar CRMs.

Comfort with lead follow-up through phone, SMS,
, and Zoom.

Experience working in a startup, founder-led business, or high-accountability environment.

Compensation



This role will begin as a part-time or contract position with a performance-based compensation structure.



Compensation may include:

Commission on closed revenue.

Bonuses for conversion milestones and monthly sales targets.

Potential base retainer for proven performers with consistent pipeline ownership.

Clear path to expanded responsibilities and increased earnings as the webinar and course ecosystem grows.



The right person should view this as an opportunity to build with a growing education platform—not simply process leads.

The Short Of It

We are a US-based commercial roofing company in Northwest Indiana with finished video content, finished landing pages, and money to spend. We need a media buyer who can take that content live across Meta 
 + Instagram), LinkedIn, and YouTube, and bring back form fills. Once these three platforms are running well, we'll expand to TikTok, Reddit, X, Pinterest, and Snap.

What You Will Actually Do

 + Instagram) with proper objective, Pixel, Conversions API, and Instant Forms.

1. YouTube Shorts campaign architecture.

1. Screenshots fro
ta Ads Manager and LinkedIn Campaign Manager showing campaigns YOU built, with spend numbers visible.

mber.

title: Junior Video Editor
description:
*** Please read the entire post before applying. Thanks! ***



*** About the Role ***



If you want editing work that actually matters, this is it!



Engage Video Production (EVP) creates educational and communication-focused video for aerospace, defense, and other technical clients. You will help turn complex subjects into something clear and usable, whether that means explaining how satellites stay in orbit, helping engineers communicate their work, or building training content people can actually follow. The work is structured and built for real-world use, not just visuals.



This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week role working directly with the Creative Director. Projects range from short explainers to long-form training content. Aerospace and defense are our core specialties, but our projects vary widely, so we need an editor who is adaptable, technically proficient, and comfortable shifting styles to fit each client's goals.



If you need reminders to respond or follow up, this is not a fit. If you spot issues early, communicate clearly, and take ownership of your work, keep reading.



*** The Three Pillars of Success at EVP ***



To succeed here, you need to live these three values:



Discipline: You follow through on every task without floundering or ghosting. You manage your time and meet deadlines without constant supervision.



Ownership / Initiative: You do more than complete tasks. You look for ways to improve the work and support the team.



Integrity / Accountability: You own your mistakes right away. You have the backbone to point out errors for correction, even your own, because precision here is non-negotiable.



*** Role Overview ***



You will execute the editing of active projects under the guidance of our Creative Director. Aside from syncs and updates to align on priorities, you work independently. You are responsible for your output, your timeline, and how you communicate progress.



The ideal candidate works independently on assigned tasks, manages large volumes of data, and communicates proactively. You take pride in technical accuracy and understand how a project's storytelling drives results for the client.



*** Core Responsibilities ***



Video Editing: Edit short- and long-form content from start to finish, with strong storytelling and pacing on every project.



Media Management: Organize, sync, and manage large volumes of footage. You must be comfortable with projects ranging from hundreds of gigabytes to multiple terabytes.



Technical Finishing: Perform professional color correction and grading on all deliverables, including RAW workflows, and keep visual consistency.



Audio and Sound Design: Integrate music, handle basic audio cleanup and mixing, and make sure sound design fits the project's goals.



Graphics: Apply motion graphics, titles, and lower thirds as the project requires, for a polished, professional product.



Feedback and Coordination: Implement revisions efficiently and meet agreed deadlines. You will coordinate daily with the Creative Director and, when applicable, other editors or freelancers.



Communication: This is part of the job, not an extra. Send progress updates as needed, flag blockers early and suggest solutions, and stay aligned with the Creative Director and company priorities. Silent work does not fly here.



*** Required Qualifications ***



Professional Background: Real experience in video editing (freelance or agency), with a solid grasp of pacing, storytelling, and professional delivery formats.



Software: Solid working proficiency in DaVinci Resolve or Adobe Premiere Pro. Resolve is our preferred NLE, but we welcome expert Premiere editors who deliver professional results.



Technical Foundations: Strong audio cleanup and mixing, plus color correction and grading workflows.



RAW Workflow (Preferred): Experience editing and grading RED RAW footage. If you have not handled RED RAW, you must be a fast learner who can manage complex, high-resolution media.



Data and Infrastructure: A reliable, high-speed internet connection is non-negotiable. You will regularly receive hundreds of gigabytes to terabytes of footage and must be comfortable managing that volume.



Autonomy and Communication: Excellent written English and a proactive approach to reporting. You work without micromanagement and stay vocal about timelines, challenges, and progress.



*** Bonus / Preferred Skills ***



- Motion graphics (Fusion, After Effects, or similar)

- Graphic design for diagrams or visual explainers

- Experience with technical, educational, or corporate content

- Familiarity with 
 or structured feedback workflows

- Interest in aerospace, defense, or technical subjects



*** Compensation ***



Hourly Rate: $4.00 to $8.00 USD per hour. Your starting rate depends on experience and demonstrated skill.

This is a full-time role and full-time is what we are after. That said, if you are clearly qualified but can only commit part-time right now, apply anyway and tell us your availability.



Full-Time (40 hrs/week): $640 to $1,280 USD per month (about 39,000 to 78,000 PHP).

Part-Time (20 hrs/week): $320 to $640 USD per month (about 20,000 to 39,000 PHP).

[*Conversions are approximate.]



*** A Note on AI and Judgment ***



At EVP, we use advanced tools every day. But this role requires real human judgment and radical integrity. We are hiring a human, not a prompt.



If you use AI to draft your personal responses in the "How to Apply" section, you fail the first test of this role: honesty. We want your real thoughts and your real personality so we can tell whether you fit our team. If your application has no genuine human voice, it will be discarded. Use AI to assist your workflow later. Do not use it to represent your character now.



*** How to Apply ***



Follow these steps exactly. Attention to detail is part of the job.



- Set your subject line to: "Passionate Video Editor - [Your Name]"

- Use a minimum of 7 apply points (AP).

- Provide a link to your best and most current editing work. Include anything you want to highlight, such as motion-graphics-heavy editing. No portfolio means no consideration.

- State the 10th word of our "Three Pillars" section.

- In exactly two sentences, describe your experience with RED RAW footage. If you have none, explain how you plan to handle the learning curve and hardware demands of high-resolution RAW media. Plain English only. No AI-generated fluff.

- Attach or link to your CV/resume in PDF format only.

- Want to stand out? Record a 60-second video (Loom or similar) introducing yourself. Tell me why you are the right pick and what interests you about aerospace and defense. Start the video by addressing me by name (Ryan). Applicants who include this video move to the top of the list.



Thanks for your time and genuine interest.

• Multiple monitors required (single monitor setups are not suitable).

• High-quality headset with microphone.

• Reliable webcam.

• Quiet, professional workspace suitable for full-day Zoom collaboration.



What You Bring

Accounting Experience: Previous experience in accounts receivable, accounts payable, invoicing, or bookkeeping support is required. Experience working in remote or virtual accounting environments preferred.

Technical Proficiency: Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel. Comfortable working across multiple systems, databases, and accounting platforms simultaneously.

Organization: You can handle high
 volumes, prioritize tasks, and keep everything on track.

Composed Under Pressure: You enjoy working within tight deadlines with close attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.

description:
The Role:



We are looking for a highly skilled, fiercely organised, and trustworthy Remote Financial Controller to take complete ownership of our company’s finances. You will be the financial backbone of our business—bridging the gap between meticulous bookkeeping and strategic CFO-level thinking.



We don't want someone who just waits for instructions. Key Responsibilities:

- Impeccable Bookkeeping & Systems Management:

- Take full ownership of daily bookkeeping, maintaining an obsessive level of data accuracy.

- Reconcile all bank and credit card transactions, meticulously matching payments in both Odoo and Xero, ensuring the two systems are perfectly synchronised and up-to-date at all times.

- Manage accounts payable (AP) and accounts receivable (AR). Report them to Management regularly.

- Handle AR Collections: Confidently and professionally call clients to follow up on overdue invoices, ensuring timely payments while maintaining excellent client relationships.
