- Chase down tea
mbers (including the founders) for missing receipts or invoices—you must be comfortable holding management accountable to compliance.

- Maintain a Zero
 policy



Process Improvement & Automation:

- Constantly audit our financial workflows. If a process isn't bulletproof, you are expected to redesign it and present your ideas. implementing rigorous cross-checks and double-validation points to eliminate errors.

- Leverage AI tools and modern software automation to reduce manual data entry, streamline reporting, and increase overall efficiency.



Reporting & "CFO-Level" Strategy:

- Prepare and present accurate end-of-month (EOM), quarterly financial statements.

- Develop and maintain rolling cash flow forecasts to guide business decisions.

- Track and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) pulled from both Xero and Odoo.

- Prepare data for BAS (Business Activity Statements) and liaise with our accountant for lodging.



Requirements & Qualifications:

- Extreme Autonomy: You do not need to be micro-managed or reminded to do your job. You organise your own schedule, hit your deadlines, and proactively communicate your progress.

- Super Attention to Detail: You despise data entry errors, you naturally spot discrepancies that others miss, and you always double-check your own work before submitting it.

- Assertive Communication & Excellent English: Flawless written and highly proficient spoken English. You must be completely comfortable picking up the phone to call a client about a late payment, and equally unafraid to speak up, ask tough questions, or push back respectfully internally when needed.

- Software & Tech Mastery: * Expert-level, certified knowledge of Xero.

- Knowledge of Odoo is a plus

- Experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, automated data extraction) to improve accounting workflows.

- Experience: Minimum 5+ years of experience in bookkeeping, accounting, or financial management. 

- Understanding the Australian accounting system, GST, BAS, IAS, etc is a must

- Prior experience working with Australian companies is a must

- understanding of Inventory tracking is a plus.

title: Part-Time Bookkeeper / Accounting Support
description:
About Elite 8 Tax Relief & Business Advisors:

We are a dynamic financial services firm dedicated to providing tailored tax preparation, bookkeeping, and financial services to both individuals and businesses. Our approach is client-centric, ensuring personalized service that meets the unique needs of each client for optimal outcomes. Staying abreast of tax law and financial trends, our expert team is committed to continuous learning and adaptation. Our mission is to empower clients by maintaining their financial health today and proactively planning for their tomorrow.



Role Overview:



Elite 8 Tax Relief & Business Advisors is seeking a highly capable Bookkeeper / Accounting Support Contractor to support client bookkeeping, accounting cleanup, financial reporting, and advisory preparation work. This role is ideal for a self-directed accounting professional who understands bookkeeping is more than data entry. We need someone who can review financial activity, identify issues, communicate clearly, meet deadlines, and help maintain clean, decision-ready books for business clients.

The role involves managing QuickBooks accounts, supporting clients, and contributing to our team's collaborative efforts to meet client needs. The ideal candidate has strong QuickBooks Online and Xero experience, understands accounting fundamentals, can manage client accounts independently, and communicates proactively when questions, issues, or bottlenecks arise. This role requires professional judgment, accountability, and the ability to work with limited supervision.



Primary Responsibilities:



Bookkeeping & Account Management

Maintain accurate books for assigned client accounts.

Categorize transactions properly based on client activity and accounting principles.

Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, loans, merchant accounts, payroll accounts, and other balance sheet accounts.

Review financial statements for obvious errors, inconsistencies, unusual balances, and missing activity.

Maintain clean, organized, and supportable books for each client.

Assist with monthly, quarterly, and annual bookkeeping close processes.

Track outstanding client questions, missing documents, and unresolved transactions.

Support cleanup and catch-up bookkeeping projects when assigned.

Prepare client books for tax preparation, tax planning, or advisory review.



Accounting Review & Quality Control

Identify uncategorized, misclassified, duplicate, or unsupported transactions.

Review balance sheet accounts for reasonableness.

Flag negative loan balances, shareholder distributions, owner draws, retained earnings issues, payroll inconsistencies, and unusual expense activity.

Understand the difference between ordinary expenses, capital assets, loans, equity, distributions, and reimbursements.

Recognize when depreciation, amortization, fixed assets, loan treatment, payroll, or tax-sensitive classifications may require review.

Maintain documentation for bookkeeping decisions and client-provided support.

Escalate technical questions before making unsupported assumptions.



Software & Workflow

Work primarily in QuickBooks Online and Xero.

Use firm-approved project management, document management, and communication tools.

Follow established client workflows, task assignments, naming conventions, and deadlines.

Update task status clearly and consistently.

Document work performed, open issues, assumptions, and pending client needs.

Assist with process improvement when recurring problems are identified.



Client & Team Communication

Communicate clearly in writing and verbally.

Provide concise updates on work status, missing information, and client issues.

Ask focused questions when clarification is needed.

Communicate challenges early enough to protect deadlines.

Provide proposed solutions whenever possible.

Participate in scheduled internal check-ins as needed.

Maintain professionalism and confidentiality at all times.



Required Qualifications

Minimum 3 years of bookkeeping or accounting experience.

Experience supporting tax firms, accounting firms, or advisory practices.

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field.

Both QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor and Xero Advisor Certifications.

Experience independently managing client bookkeeping accounts.

Strong understanding of GAAP fundamentals.

Experience with multiple business types and industries.

Familiarity with U.S. small business tax concepts.

Familiarity with tax-sensitive bookkeeping concepts, including depreciation, capital assets, loans, payroll, owner equity, and deductible versus nondeductible expenses.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Must be able to pass a background check and be bondable due to access to confidential client financial information.

Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive financial data.



Preferred Qualifications

Have at least two U.S. based references.

Experience preparing books for tax preparation or tax planning.

Payroll bookkeeping experience.

Experience with real estate, medical practices, professional services, construction, cannabis, retail, or service-based businesses.

Experience with cleanup bookkeeping projects.

Experience using workflow tools such as TaxDome, Basecamp, Trello, Asana, Karbon, Financial Cents, or similar platforms.

Experience with document request workflows and client communication tracking.



Technology, Security & Data Protection Requirements

Because this role involves access to confidential client financial records, tax-related documents, bookkeeping systems, and firm information, the contractor must maintain a secure remote work environment and comply with all firm technology and data protection requirements.



The contractor must be able to meet and maintain minimum security standards, including but not limited to:

Reliable high-speed internet connection.

Secure, password-protected computer used for professional work.

Updated operating system and software.

Active anti-malware / antivirus protection.

Properly configured firewall protection.

Use of a firm-approved VPN when required.

Multi-factor authentication for all approved systems.

Secure password management practices.

No shared use of firm logins, client files, or confidential data.

No saving client documents to unauthorized personal devices, drives, or cloud storage.

Compliance with all firm procedures for document access, storage, transmission, and deletion.



The contractor must promptly report any suspected security issue, lost or compromised device, unauthorized access, malware i
, password compromise, or data exposure concern.



Failure to maintain required security standards may result in immediate removal of system access and termination of the contractor relationship.



Background Check, Bondability & Trust Requirements

Because this role involves access to sensitive client financial records, business accounts, tax-related documents, and confidential firm information, candidates must be able to successfully complete a background check and be bondable.

The selected contractor must demonstrate a professional history suitable for handling confidential financial information, client records, bookkeeping systems, and related account access. Any background concern that may affect financial trust, confidentiality, client security, or professional reliability must be disclosed during the screening process.

Candidates must also agree to follow all firm confidentiality, data security, document handling, password management, and client privacy requirements.



Contractor Classification

This is an independent contractor role. The contractor is responsible for managing their own work environment, equipment, internet access, taxes, insurance, and any other obligations associated with independent contractor status. This role does not create an employer-employee relationship.



Application Process

Application Deadline: June 8th 11:59 AM Philippine Standard Time.

Interested candidates should complete our application: 



Elite 8 Tax & Business Advisors is an equal opportunity employer, valuing diversity and committed to creating an inclusive environment.



*Important Note* Please do not directly contact anyone on our team. We are thoroughly reviewing each application and will provide communication to everyone about their status moving forward.

title: Unreal Engine Game Developer
description:
Who We Are:

At Happy Little Games, games are art. We are an independent studio built by gamers, for gamers, making the kinds of games we would want to play ourselves. We care about creating games that are fun, memorable, and worth the time players spend with them. Every project is a chance to build something distinct that we are genuinely proud of.



Why Work Here:

If you love games and enjoy building things, this is a place where you can do both in a flexible, supportive environment. We are fully remote, you can set your own schedule, and we do not believe in crunch. We care about the quality of your work and whether you get things done, not how many hours you sit at a desk.



You also get to work closely with a small team and decide how you want to grow. You can deepen your expertise in the work you already enjoy, explore other areas of game development, or grow into a different role over time. Being good at one thing does not mean you have to do only that thing forever.



Role Overview

* Build and prototype gameplay features in Unreal Engine using Blueprints.

* Work on gameplay systems, basic AI, physics, interactions, and related gameplay functionality.

* Create focused test environments that clearly show how a feature works.

* Test and debug your own work before submitting it for review.

* Keep implementation focused on the requested scope and avoid unnecessary files, systems, or dependencies.

* Document what you build, how it works, and how it should be tested.

* Manage assigned user stories, communicate progress, and raise questions, blockers, or risks early.

* Learn and follow the studio’s technical standards, workflows, and development practices.





What You Need to Bring:

You do not need to know every Unreal Engine system before joining us, but you should already be able to work productively without constant step-by-step instruction. You should already be able to:



* Work comfortably within Unreal Engine.

* Build functional gameplay features using Blueprints.

* Build simple gameplay systems and basic AI behavior.

* Apply basic software-development principles, including logic, data flow, organization, and debugging.

* Test and debug your own work before submitting it for review.

* Test both the expected behavior and a basic control case where the feature should not activate or behave the same way.

* Research unfamiliar but well-documented problems and make reasonable progress independently.

* Manage your own time and keep assigned work moving toward completion.

* Keep your work focused on the requested scope.

* Ask useful questions when requirements or technical direction are unclear.

* Communicate progress, blockers, and risks early.

* Create and maintain basic documentation for your work.

* Keep project files and implementation reasonably clean and organized.

* Explain how your work functions and why you made important implementation decisions.

* Remain professional, dependable, and honest about what you do and do not know.



What You Can Learn Here:

You are not required to already know every tool, framework, or production practice used by the studio. You can learn or further develop the following after joining:



* Git and the studio’s source-control workflow.

* Notion and the studio’s user-story workflow.

* Agile and Scrum practices.

* The Gameplay Ability System and how it is used within our projects.

* The studio’s architecture, naming conventions, and technical standards.

* Formal system-design and diagramming practices.

* Stronger documentation practices.

* Multiplayer replication.

* Basic C++ as your responsibilities grow.

* More advanced gameplay, AI, animation, physics, and Unreal Engine systems.



You should be willing to research these areas, learn from available documentation and examples, and apply feedback to future work.



Compensation:

Your final hourly rate will be based on your experience, demonstrated skills, technical ability, communication, and level of independence. We will determine the appropriate rate through the interview and trial process.



Work Progression:

New developers begin with a trial project so we can evaluate how they work, communicate, and deliver against a real set of requirements. Developers who complete the trial successfully may continue with project-based work. From there, strong and consistent contributors may move into hourly work as availability and studio needs allow.

As the company grows, hourly developers may also have the opportunity to move into a full-time role if both sides are interested.



How to Apply:

Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph whenever possible and include your resume, portfolio, and any relevant Unreal Engine work samples. If you are unable to contact us through OnlineJobs.ph for any reason, you may also reach us via
. Please include the position you are applying for in the subject line.

title: Creative Strategist & Producer (Meta Ads) - High-Volume AI Video & Static Creative
description:
We're a performance-based lead generation company running Meta advertising campaigns across two verticals: healthcare intake and legal case intake. We need someone who can both think and produce, researching what's actually working in the market and then turning that research into a high volume of finished, ready-to-run ad creatives every single week.



This is not a slow, one-creative-at-a-time role. We need 30-60+ finished images and videos per week across both verticals, and every single one needs to be high quality, not rushed or generic. Speed without quality doesn't work here, and quality without speed doesn't either, we need both.



You'll be responsible for the full loop: researching competitors, identifying winning hooks and angles, writing the copy and scripts, and producing the finished assets yourself using AI creative tools. You're not handing off briefs to someone else to build, you are the one building.



**Responsibilities**

- Continuously research competitor ads running in the addiction treatment and lemon law space, across all formats: static, AI UGC, talking head video, and traditional creative

- Identify winning hooks, angles, and formats based on what's actually converting in the market, not just what looks good

- Write ad copy and scripts based on that research

- Produce 30-60+ finished, ready-to-run Meta ad creatives per week, a mix of static images and AI-generated videos

- Use AI creative tools including HeyGen, Higgsfield, Nano Banana, and similar platforms to produce realistic talking head and UGC-style video content at scale

- Build static image ads using design tools for Meta placements

- Take feedback and produce revisions/iterations quickly, same day turnaround on requested changes

- Stay current on new AI creative tools as they emerge and bring new formats to the table proactively

- Track which creative types and formats are performing best and adjust production focus accordingly



**Requirements**

- Proven experience producing high volume performance ad creative specifically for paid social, not branding or organic content

- Hands-on experience with AI video/avatar tools including HeyGen, Higgsfield, Nano Banana, Kling, or similar platforms, you need to already know how to use these, not learn on the job

- Strong copywriting ability, you're writing your own scripts and ad copy based on research, not waiting on someone else

- Experience researching competitor ads and translating that research into new creative concepts

- Proficiency with static image design tools (Photoshop, Canva, or similar)

- Demonstrated ability to produce at high volume without sacrificing quality, this role requires real speed

- Fast, reliable communication, you need to be reachable and responsive, this is not a role where we wait days for updates or revisions

- Comfortable taking feedback and turning around iterations quickly

- Experience with healthcare, legal, insurance, or another high-CPL/high-stakes vertical is a strong plus

- Strong written English for daily collaboration with a US-based team



**Structure:** Open to full-time or contract, based on fit



**How to Apply**

Submit your portfolio with specific examples of AI-generated video ads and static ads you've produced for paid social, ideally lead generation work. Include the tools you used for each example.



As part of your application, complete this exercise:



Pick one vertical, either addiction treatment or lemon law. Find one active Meta ad running in that space and tell us what's working about it and what you'd change. Then produce one new creative, either a static image or a short AI-generated video, that you think would outperform it, using any of the tools listed above. Send us the finished asset along with a short explanation of your thinking.



We're not looking for a perfect ad, we're looking to see how fast you can move from research to a finished, usable creative, and how you think while doing it. This exercise is the part of the application we weigh most heavily.

title: AI Video Creator / Motion Designer (Contract or Part-Time)
description:
THE REFERENCE — STUDY THIS VIDEO



Watch this before applying: 



"Comcast Commercial #1 (2026) Featuring Liev Schreiber" Directed by Dante Ariola / MJZ — Agency: Goodby Silverstein & Partners



This is the tone, pacing, and visual standard we are targeting. Your work does not need to match a $500K production budget, but it needs to match the FEEL. Here is what makes this commercial work — and what we need you to replicate:



TONE



Authoritative but not aggressive. Confident, measured, quiet power.

Feels like a prestige drama, not a sales pitch.

The narrator (Schreiber) speaks TO the viewer as an equal — not down to them, not hyping them up. Straightforward. Intelligent. Calm.

No hype. No "act now." No countdown timers. No stock-photo energy.



VISUAL STYLE



Cinematic color grading: desaturated, cool tones, deep contrast.

Clean, modern typography — data and numbers appear on screen as the narrator references them. Sans-serif. White or gold on dark.

Real-world footage intercut with data visualizations and motion graphics.

Slow, deliberate camera movement. No fast cuts. Each shot breathes.

Dynamic visuals proving scale — numbers animate in, graphics build.

Dark backgrounds dominate. Light is used intentionally, not flooded.



PACING



Measured. Every sentence gets space. No rush.

Music is low, cinematic, ambient — supports the voice, never competes.

Roughly 1 key visual per sentence. Not cluttered.

The viewer should feel like they are watching something important.

SOUND



Deep, resonant voiceover — professional narrator with gravitas.

Minimal sound design. No whooshes, no stingers, no comedic beats.

Subtle ambient score. Cinematic. Think Hans Zimmer at 10% volume.



WHAT YOU WILL PRODUCE

3-minute educational videos (we provide the scripts). Initial batch of 22 videos across 5 modules, plus 4 marketing/ad videos.



Topics include:



The Rockefeller Method (what it is, how it works)

Velocity Banking (debt elimination strategy)

Capital Deployment (real estate, oil & gas)

Tax Strategy (cost segregation, bonus depreciation)

Case Studies (military officer, pilot, engineer, veteran)

Marketing ads (The Problem, The System, The Execution, The Offer)

For each video, you will receive:



Full script with dialogue and scene descriptions

Visual direction notes (shot types, graphics, animations)

Brand guidelines (colors, fonts, logo placement)

You will deliver:



Finished 3-minute video (1920x1080 or 4K, .mp4)

Vertical cut for social (9:16, 60-second highlight)

Thumbnail image (1280x720)



REQUIRED SKILLS

MUST HAVE: 

[ ] Proficiency with AI video generation tools (Runway, Pika, Kling, Sora, HailuoAI, or similar). You should be producing with these daily. 

[ ] Strong motion graphics ability (After Effects, or AI equivalent). Animated typography, data visualizations, flow diagrams. 

[ ] Understanding of cinematic color grading and composition. 

[ ] Ability to source or generate high-quality voiceover (ElevenLabs, professional VO talent, or your own studio-quality voice). 

[ ] Clean, modern design sensibility. If your portfolio has neon gradients, particle effects, or "techy" overlays, this is not the right fit.



NICE TO HAVE:

[ ] Experience with financial services, real estate, or insurance content. 

[ ] Familiarity with the Infinite Banking Concept or wealth strategy space.

[ ] Ability to produce cinematic b-roll using AI (cityscapes, office environments, family scenes, military settings). 

[ ] Music licensing or production (or access to Artlist, Epidemic Sound).



DO NOT APPLY IF:



Your work looks like a TikTok edit or a "motivational" Instagram reel.

You rely on stock footage montages with no original motion design.

You cannot match the desaturated, high-contrast, dark visual palette shown in the reference video.

You think "corporate video" means bright blue backgrounds with icons flying around. That is the opposite of what we want.



PORTFOLIO LINK

Show us 3–5 pieces that demonstrate the cinematic, authoritative tone described above. If nothing in your current portfolio matches, produce a 30-second sample using one of our scripts (provided on request).



TOOLS LIST 

Tell us exactly which AI tools you use for generation, editing, motion graphics, voiceover, and music. We want to know your actual workflow, not a list of tools you have heard of.



TURNAROUND ESTIMATE

 How many days per finished 3-minute video? Be realistic. We value quality over speed, but we need a sustainable cadence.



RATE 

Per-video rate for the deliverables described above (landscape video, vertical cut, thumbnail). If you prefer hourly, state that.



ONE SENTENCE

Watch the Comcast reference video and tell us in one sentence what makes it work. This tells us whether you see what we see.



TIMELINE & VOLUME

Phase 1: 4 marketing videos (highest priority — paid ads) 

Phase 2: Module 1 (5 videos) — Rockefeller Method foundations 

Phase 3: Modules 2–5 (17 videos) — ongoing, 2–3 per week



Total: 26 videos over approximately 10–12 weeks. Ongoing work available as we expand the curriculum and ad campaigns.



ABOUT THE ROLE

This is not a one-off gig. We are building a media engine. The right person becomes our go-to video creator across all four entities (Velocity Capital, Anza Ventures, Anza Realtor, Anza Construction). Consistent work, clear creative direction, and scripts provided for every piece.



We are looking for someone who takes pride in craft. Someone who watches the Comcast spot and thinks: 

"I can do that — and I can do it faster with AI."

title: Real Estate Acquisitions Shark
description:
JOB TITLE: HIGH-TICKET CLOSER / REAL ESTATE ACQUISITIONS SHARK



Enterprises Elite ( IG 470K+ 
/enterpriseselite/ ) is a real estate investment company that is rapidly scaling our virtual wholesaling operation. Our marketing machine is generating more leads than our current team can handle. We do not need help finding leads; we need a killer to close them.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS

We are looking for an experienced, relentless remote Acquisitions Manager. You will be taking warm leads, running property comps, negotiating directly with American homeowners, and locking up real estate contracts.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

This is not a customer service or basic virtual assistant role. This is not for order-takers or appointment setters. If you are overly polite, afraid of conflict, or fold the second a seller gets aggressive, do not apply. We need a shark. We need someone who is perfectly comfortable telling a homeowner their house needs $40,000 in work, making a low offer, and confidently sitting in the awkward silence.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Call warm, inbound leads and follow up with our CRM pipeline. Quickly analyze properties using online tools to determine the After Repair Value (ARV) and Maximum Allowable Offer (MAO). Build deep rapport with distressed sellers, uncover their actual pain points, and overcome brutal price objections. Negotiate heavy discounts and secure digital contracts.



REQUIREMENTS TO WIN

PERFECT ENGLISH: Your spoken English must be flawless, with high confidence and strong tonality.

EXPERIENCE: You must have a proven track record of closing high-ticket B2B/B2C sales, preferably in U.S. real estate wholesaling.

TECH FLUENT: You must know how to navigate CRMs and run comps.



THE COMPENSATION

We offer a highly competitive base hourly rate to give you stability, plus an aggressive, uncapped commission bonus for every single contract you lock up that closes. If you are a true closer, you will make significantly more here than standard VA roles.



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)

If you just click apply and send a generic resume, it will be instantly deleted. To prove you have attention to detail and strong communication skills, you must follow these exact steps:



STEP 1: Make the subject line of your message exactly ELITE CLOSER - [Your Name]

STEP 2: Do not send a cover letter. Instead, record a short 60 to 90-second video of yourself on your phone or webcam.

STEP 3: In the video, introduce yourself, tell us about your highest-ticket sales experience, and explain exactly why you would be a killer fit for this acquisitions role.

STEP 4: Upload the video to Google Drive, Dropbox, or YouTube (make sure the privacy is set so anyone with the link can view it) and paste the link in your application.



If you cannot sell yourself on a short video, you cannot close our leads. We look forward to seeing your pitch.

title: AI Automation Builder — GoHighLevel + Voiceflow (Per Project, Ongoing Work)
description:
About Asceniq



Asceniq is a UK-based AI automation agency that builds lead conversion systems for estate agents. We deploy AI chatbots, automated follow-up sequences, and CRM pipelines that help estate agent branches capture and convert more leads without adding to their team. We are growing and looking for a skilled automation builder to join us on a per-project basis with consistent ongoing work as we bring on new clients.



What You Will Build

For each new client you will build and deliver a complete system from scratch. This includes:



A Voiceflow AI chatbot connected to the Claude API, customised to the client's brand, property listings, and FAQs — handling buyer enquiries, seller valuation requests, viewing bookings, and lead capture

A GoHighLevel sub-account configured with a lead pipeline, instant SMS and
 notification workflows, a 7-day automated follow-up sequence, and a reporting dashboard the client can log into

A webhook connection between Voiceflow and GHL so every lead captured by the chatbot automatically creates a contact in GHL and triggers the follow-up sequence

Deployment of the chatbot embed code on the client's website

A full end-to-end test of every flow before handover



You will receive a detailed brief for each client including their brand information, FAQs, team contacts, website access, and specific requirements. All builds are done under the Asceniq brand — you will never contact clients directly.



What We Are Looking For

You must have hands-on experience with all of the following:



GoHighLevel — workflows, pipelines, sub-accounts, SMS and
 automation, snapshots

Voiceflow — building multi-flow chatbot conversations, API integrations, webhook triggers

Webhook and API integrations — connecting tools together cleanly and reliably

Claude API or OpenAI API — connecting AI models to chatbot platforms



Nice to have but not required:



Experience building for real estate or property businesses

n8n or Make.com automation experience





How This Works

Each client build pays a fixed project fee of £300 — £450 depending on complexity. A standard build takes three to five days. As Asceniq grows you will receive consistent project work — our goal is to onboard two to four new clients per month. There is real potential for this to become a long-term ongoing arrangement with predictable monthly income for the right person.

We are straightforward to work with. You get a clear brief, all access credentials, and a point of contact for any questions. We review the build before it goes live and give feedback quickly. No chasing, no confusion.



To Apply

Please send the following:



A short paragraph about your experience with GoHighLevel and Voiceflow specifically

One or two examples of automation systems you have built — screenshots, Loom videos, or brief descriptions are all fine

Your availability and how many projects you can take on per month

Confirm you are comfortable working under a white-label arrangement where all work is branded as Asceniq



Applications without examples of relevant work will not be considered. We are looking for someone who has done this before, not someone learning on the job.



To be clear on what this is: this is project-based remote work with no fixed hours. You work when the project requires it and deliver within the agreed timeframe. Consistent performers will receive consistent work.

title: MYOB Bookkeeper for Bank Transaction Cleanup & Bank Feed Rules Setup
description:
I am looking for an experienced bookkeeper/accounting assistant to help clean up historical bank transactions in MYOB.



I have already imported 6,000+ bank transactions into MYOB covering multiple financial years. I need someone to review the imported transactions, assign the correct account codes/categories, and set up bank feed transaction rules so future transactions can be coded automatically.



Main tasks:



1. Review imported bank transactions in MYOB.

2. Allocate each transaction to the correct account code.

3. Identify recurring payments, income, subscriptions, bank fees, loan payments, tax payments, payroll-related transactions, transfers, and owner/director transactions.

4. Create clear and accurate bank feed rules in MYOB for recurring transactions.

5. Flag unclear transactions for review instead of guessing.

6. Help ensure the bank transactions are properly organised and ready for reconciliation/accountant review.

7. Provide a summary of completed work and any transactions requiring clarification.



Requirements:



* Strong experience with MYOB.

* Experience with Australian bookkeeping is preferred.

* Good understanding of chart of accounts and transaction coding.

* Ability to work carefully with historical bank transactions.

* Attention to detail is very important.

* Must be able to communicate clearly and ask questions when transaction purpose is unclear.

* Experience setting up MYOB bank rules is highly preferred.



This is a cleanup project first, but it may become ongoing monthly bookkeeping work if the job is done well.



Please apply with:



1. Your MYOB bookkeeping experience.

2. Whether you have worked with Australian businesses before.

3. Your hourly rate.

4. How many hours per week you are available.

5. A short explanation of how you would approach cleaning up 6,000+ imported bank transactions.

title: Long-Form Video Editor for 52K Real Estate YouTube Channel
description:
Boundless Estates is a 52,400 subscriber YouTube channel about rural and affordable real estate in the US. We're hiring a reliable long-form editor to turn our scripts and assets into finished, ready-to-upload 18 to 22 minute videos. You handle the full edit start to finish.



What you'll work with (all provided):

- A written script

- The exact ElevenLabs AI voice to use (same voice every video for brand consistency)

- Stock footage and B-roll

- Google Earth Studio fly-through footage

- Real estate listing photos



Everything is handed to you in an organized Google Drive folder and tracked in a shared sheet. No research, no scriptwriting on your end. You edit.



What you'll do:

- Generate voiceover from our script using the ElevenLabs voice we provide

- Cut and sequence footage to the voiceover

- Add motion, transitions, and Ken Burns effects on photos

- Pace tightly for retention (visual change every few seconds, no dead air)

- Add text overlays, lower thirds, captions, basic sound design

- Add royalty-free or licensed music that won't trigger YouTube copyright claims

- Color correct and clean up audio

- Deliver final, upload-ready files via Google Drive



Output expectation: 4 to 6 finished videos per month (one per week is the target). We prioritize quality and retention over volume.

Turnaround: each video delivered within 4 to 5 days of receiving assets, up to 2 rounds of revisions included.



You need to:

- Have real long-form YouTube editing experience (not reels or TikToks)

- Know Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut well

- Understand pacing and retention for voiceover videos

- Communicate clearly in English and hit deadlines



Bonus:

- Thumbnail design

- Real estate, travel, or documentary-style experience



To apply:

1. Write "BOUNDLESS" at the very top so I know you read this

2. Send links to 2 or 3 long-form videos you personally edited (full videos, not clips)

3. Tell me what software you use

4. Tell me realistically how long it takes you to edit one 20 minute video start to finish



Watch our channel before applying. Tell me one thing you'd improve about our current edits. Strong applicants will complete a short paid test edit on real footage before hiring.

title: ASSISTANT PROPERTY MANAGER & PERSONAL ASSISTANT – 40-Unit Real Estate Portfolio
description:
ABOUT THIS ROLE

I'm scaling my real estate portfolio (40 units across SF Bay Area, both long-term and mid-term Airbnbs) while running a retail consulting business and managing household responsibilities as a mother of 4. I need an organized, proactive assistant to own day-to-day operations so I can focus on growth and strategy. This is a unique opportunity to learn real estate from an experienced investor while building critical processes for a growing company.



This role works directly with me (no larger company structure yet, but that's changing). You'll get exposure to tenant management, remodeling, 1031 exchanges, permit processes, and portfolio evaluation.



THE WORK

**Daily & Weekly:**

- Tenant communication (maintenance requests, Airbnb replies, check-ins/check-outs) – respond within 24-48 hours

- Coordinate cleaners, contractors, tradespeople (plumbers, electricians, appliance repair)

- Handle procurement: furniture (Craigslist/FB Marketplace), supplies (Target), household items

- Post rental ads, reply to applicants, schedule showings

- Reconcile rent payments



**Process & Scaling:**

- Research and implement property management systems

- Put processes in place (currently a lot lives in my head)

- Research regulatory questions (Berkeley and San Francisco tenant protections, relocation ordinances, etc.)

- Help figure out accounting system, investor sourcing, operational scaling



**Household:**

- Groceries, meal help, kids' doctor appointments

- Organize/declutter, list items for sale, help with personal logistics



IDEAL CANDIDATE

- **Proactive problem-solver** who asks questions and anticipates what's needed

- **Organized & detail-oriented** – coordinate time-sensitive requests between multiple tenants and contractors without letting anything drop and fall through the cracks

- **Fast communicator** – replies within hours if not sooner; requests resolved in 2-3 days. This pace isn't for everyone, but it's critical

- **Self-starter** – you take a project, ask questions, then run with it. Constant direction won't work here.

- **Adaptable** – comfortable in unstructured, fast-moving environments. You'll be learning on the job and wearing multiple hats

- **Transparent & professional** – I work with high standards; I expect the same from my team

- **Comfortable with AI** – Claude and Gemini are great tools to make work easier as long as there are guardrails

- **Interested in real estate** – willingness to learn. I'm happy to mentor



NICE-TO-HAVES

- Real estate experience or exposure

- Project management or executive assistant background

- Familiarity with property management software or systems

- Knowledge of rental regulations, tenant law, or contractor coordination



TIME & LOGISTICS

- **Hours:** Full-time 8a-5p PST

- **Start:** Immediately



WHAT YOU'LL LEARN

Exposure to: rent control rules, Airbnb management, floor plans, city permit process, contractor coordination, real estate evaluation, 1031 exchanges, property purchases, market analysis, portfolio management, Section 8, lease agreements, and much more.



WHY WORK WITH ME

**Genuine flexibility.** This role has built-in time flexibility - it is full-time so that there is coverage during business hours, but *when* you do the work is largely up to you. It's not a high-stress role. An efficient assistant can pursue other interests, side projects, or even another part-time job during the same time window.



NOT A FIT IF:

- You need constant direction or detailed processes

- Fast communication and high urgency feel overwhelming

- You prefer slower-paced or more structured work environments

- You're looking for work with a large, established company



NEXT STEPS

Ready to apply?

1. Send resume

2. Complete application exercise 

3. Include brief note describing what appeals to you about this role



Please don't send generic applications – I carefully review personalized submissions.



Questions? Happy to chat:

title: Lead Response Specialist (Sales) | Medical Device Sales | Australia
description:
Skyn Lab is an Australian company that sells medical-grade laser equipment (Skyn Lux, Skyn X, Zimmer cooling, LED therapy) to beauty and skin clinics across Australia. Our machines are TGA-listed and used by some of the best clinics in the country. Average sale value is $80,000 to $150,000 AUD.

We're scaling our outbound and need a sharp, English-fluent Filipino VA to be the first voice and the first text our prospects see.

What you'll do:

You will be the first response on every new lead that comes through our website. Your job is to contact them within 5 minutes (by SMS, then phone call), qualify them using our cheat sheet, and book them into a demo on the calendar of our founder, George. You will NOT close the deals or quote prices, George handles that. Your job stops at "demo booked."

Daily tasks:



Monitor HubSpot for new leads, respond to each within 5 minutes via SMS and call.

Run our 4-question qualification cheat sheet on every call.

Book qualified prospects into demos using HubSpot Meetings.

Log every interaction in HubSpot (call outcome, notes, next step).

Execute the daily call list from our 14-day cadence (multiple touchpoints per lead).

Send a daily end-of-shift summary to George with demos booked and tomorrow's call list.



You must have:



Excellent spoken English with a neutral accent (you will be talking to Australian clinic owners on the phone).

2+ years experience in outbound sales, appointment setting, or SDR work.

Hands-on experience with HubSpot CRM.

Familiarity with SMS automation tools (ClickSend a plus, willing to learn if not).

Reliable internet (10+ Mbps) and a quiet workspace with a quality headset.

Comfortable on the phone with high-ticket B2B prospects (you'll be talking to business owners).



Nice to have:



Experience with Aircall, OpenPhone, or similar VoIP tools.

Background in medical device, aesthetic clinic, or healthcare sales.

Prior work with Australian or UK/US clients.



Pay structure:



$8 USD/hour to start, $10/hour after 60 days based on performance.

$50 USD bonus per demo booked beyond 12/month.

Paid weekly via Wise or PayPal.



How to apply:

Send a short message explaining why you're a fit. Include:



Your spoken English self-rating (1-10) and a 30-second voice recording introducing yourself.

Your HubSpot experience (how many years, what tasks).

One example of a sales/SDR result you're proud of.



Strong candidates will be sent a short written test (drafting an SMS to a clinic owner). Top performers move to a 30-minute Zoom interview.

Looking to hire within 7 days.

title: AI Prompt Engineer — Creative & Product
description:
About the Role

Aurify is looking for a Creative AI Prompt Engineer to join our product team. You'll build and refine prompts and workflows across generative AI tools (Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, image/video/voice models, and more) to produce content with real viral potential. This role blends a sharp creative eye with technical prompt-crafting skill — you'll be the person who can look at a photo, a clip, or a concept and know whether it has what it takes to break out, then know exactly how to prompt the right AI tools to get there.



What You'll Do

• Build, test, and refine prompts and workflows across multiple AI tools (Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, image/video generation models, LLMs) to produce high-quality creative output

• Identify and select source content (photos, clips, concepts) with strong viral potential

• Develop repeatable prompt templates and workflows that the product team can use and scale

• Iterate quickly based on performance data and creative feedback

• Fluent English (written and spoken)

• Hands-on experience with prompt engineering across multiple AI tools — ideally including Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, or similar image/video/voice generation platforms

• Based in or willing to work full-time in Seoul



Nice to Have

Why Join Aurify

title: Accountant
description:
The Accountant is responsible for managing payroll, company and personal tax compliance, and financial reporting, with a strong focus on Philippine and Australian taxation. This role will oversee the financial and statutory requirements of the company’s Philippine entity while ensuring compliance with both local and international tax obligations. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, highly knowledgeable in cross-border tax matters, and capable of working independently.



What You Do:

Accounting & Financial Management

-Manage day-to-day accounting activities for the Philippine entity

-Maintain accurate financial records, ledgers, and reconciliations

-Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports

-Ensure compliance with internal controls and accounting standards

Payroll Management

-Process payroll accurately and on time

-Manage statutory contributions and deductions (e.g., SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, PAYG where applicable)

-Prepare payroll reports and resolve payroll-related inquiries

-Ensure compliance with local labor and payroll regulations

Tax Compliance & Reporting

-Prepare, file, and manage company tax obligations in the Philippines and Australia

-Handle personal tax filings for company principals, as required

-Ensure timely filing and payment of income tax, VAT/GST, withholding taxes, and other statutory taxes

-Liaise with tax authorities (BIR, ATO) and external auditors or tax advisors

-Stay up to date with changes in Philippine and Australian tax laws and regulations

Entity & Regulatory Management

-Manage statutory compliance for the Philippine entity, including registrations, renewals, and filings

-Coordinate with local regulators and external service providers as needed

-Support audits, assessments, and regulatory reviews

-Maintain compliance calendars and documentation



Who You Are

-Bachelor’s degree holder in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

-CPA or equivalent professional qualification preferred

-5+ years of accounting experience, including payroll and tax compliance

-Strong experience with Xero

-Strong working knowledge of Philippine tax laws and regulations

-Familiarity with Australian taxation (income tax, GST, PAYG, BAS)

-Experience managing or supporting a Philippine corporate entity

-Proficiency in accounting software and payroll systems

-Experience with cross-border or multinational companies (preferred)

-Experience handling personal tax filings in addition to corporate tax (preferred)



What You Must Have

-Strong attention to detail and accuracy

-High level of integrity and confidentiality

-Excellent organisational and time-management skills

-Ability to work independently and meet strict deadlines

-Clear written and verbal communication skills



To apply: Send an
 to 
 with the subject “ACCOUNTANT – OLJ”. Please include your city and attach your resume (PDF) or share a link. We look forward to learning more about you!

title: Sales Representative / Lead Generation
description:
Outbound Sales Representative (Base Pay + $ Per Booking + Bonuses)

Earn More by Closing More Sales!



Marching Maids is a fast-growing house cleaning company serving customers throughout Southern California and Denver. We are looking for a highly motivated, competitive, and money-driven Sales Representative who enjoys talking with people and closing sales.



This is primarily a SALES position (approximately 80%), with the remaining 20% focused on assisting existing customers.



Most of your day will be spent calling warm leads—customers who have previously used our service—to encourage them to schedule another house cleaning or sign up for recurring service.



If you're someone who enjoys sales, likes earning commissions, and wants your effort to directly impact your paycheck, we'd love to hear from you.



Compensation

Competitive hourly pay

$5 bonus for every completed booking

Additional performance bonuses available for top performers

Opportunity for long-term growth with our company



The more customers you book, the more you earn.



What You'll Do

Sales (80%)

Call past customers from our CRM and encourage them to book another cleaning.

Recommend recurring cleaning services.

Follow up with customers who previously requested quotes.

Respond to text messages from prospective customers.

Record detailed notes inside our CRM.

Meet daily outbound call and booking goals.

Handle objections confidently and professionally.

Consistently look for opportunities to increase sales.

Customer Service (20%)

Provide pricing and service information.

Schedule new customer appointments.

Reschedule existing appointments.

Update customer billing information.

Answer questions about current bookings.

Deliver excellent customer service while maintaining a positive attitude.

Daily Expectations (KPIs)



Success in this role requires consistent outbound activity.



You should expect to:



Make 50-75 outbound calls per shift, depending on conversation length.

Follow up with leads by phone and text.

Consistently work through assigned customer lists.

Meet booking and conversion goals.

Keep CRM notes accurate and up to date.

We're Looking For Someone Who Is...

Motivated by earning money.

Competitive and goal-oriented.

Confident speaking on the phone for several hours each day.

Comfortable making outbound sales calls.

Self-motivated and productive without constant supervision.

Persistent and skilled at overcoming objections.

Friendly, professional, and personable.

Organized and detail-oriented.

Fluent in spoken and written English.

Comfortable learning new software.

Preferred Experience

Outbound sales

Appointment setting

Inside sales

BPO sales

Customer service

Experience with U.S. customers

House cleaning industry experience (Tidy, Homeaglow, MaidPro, etc.) is a plus.

Experience with GoHighLevel, Launch27, or other CRM software is a plus.

Work Schedule

Monday through Saturday

8:00 AM - 2:00 PM Pacific Time (Los Angeles)

Approximately 36 hours per week

Equipment Requirements



You must have:



Fast and reliable internet

Quiet home office

Computer capable of running multiple browser tabs + Additional Screen

High-quality headset with a clear microphone

Backup internet connection (preferred)

What Success Looks Like



The ideal person enjoys talking with customers, stays positive throughout the day, consistently makes outbound calls without needing reminders, and takes pride in converting previous customers into repeat clients.



This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants a stable, long-term position where strong sales performance is rewarded.



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions:



Tell us about your outbound sales experience.

What is your biggest sales achievement?

Have you worked with U.S. customers before?

What CRM software have you used?

Why do you believe you would be successful in this role?

Please include a 1-2 minute voice recording introducing yourself so we can evaluate your English communication skills.

What are your salary expectations?

What motivates you to succeed in sales?



To show you've read this entire job posting, please begin your application with the words: "Ready to Close!"

Luxury Jewelry Brand & Personal Brand

title: Long-Term VA for US Medical Education Company — GHL Expertise Required, Path to Full-Time
description:
ABOUT SCIMPLE EDUCATION

Scimple Education is a fast-growing US-based medical education company changing how clinicians learn - through live conferences, on-demand courses, interactive content, and podcasts. We're expanding our marketing team to keep up with our growth.





THE ROLE

We're hiring a Funnel Architect / Marketing Builder - a hands-on creative who can build landing pages, design and ship
 sequences, and architect funnels end-to-end inside Kajabi and GoHighLevel. This is a long-term remote position with a clear path to full-time employment and leadership for the right person. You won't be a task-taker - you'll be the person we trust to take a campaign from blank page to live and converting.



Hours: 20-30 hrs/week to start, with a clear path to full-time within 3-6 months for the right person.



Compensation: $11-$14/hr depending on experience, plus performance bonuses and a 13th-month bonus after 12 months.



Schedule: Mostly async - you own your own hours and work when you're sharpest. We just need about 2 hours per week of overlap with US Eastern (3pm-9pm EST = morning-to-mid-day Manila) for team syncs, set by mutual agreement. The rest of the week is yours.



Location: Fully remote.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Phase 1 - Build & Launch (first 60-90 days)



Build landing pages from scratch in Kajabi and/or GoHighLevel - not just maintain them. You own page structure, design, and conversion logic.



Architect, build, and ship
 sequences and funnels - welcome flows, post-purchase sequences, upsell paths, re-engagement campaigns. You design the architecture, write the brief for AI-assisted copy, and edit the output until it's ready to send.



Produce on-brand visual assets in Canva, Nano Banana, and similar tools - landing page graphics, social posts,
 headers, promo imagery.



Maintain customer databases, monitor performance analytics, and iterate based on what the numbers tell you.



Support newsletter and promotional content production end-to-end.





Phase 2 - Scale & Optimize (after training)

Lead the marketing build for new course launches, conference promotion, and product releases.



Run A/B tests on landing pages,
 subject lines, and funnel steps. Bring the data back and recommend changes.



Coordinate with speakers, faculty, and vendors on promotional rollouts for live and virtual events.



Help launch new courses, products, and programs from a marketing-build perspective.





MUST-HAVES

Exceptional written and spoken English.



Advanced Google Workspace skills (Docs, Sheets, Drive - non-negotiable).



Hands-on experience building (not just maintaining) inside Kajabi or GoHighLevel. This is the single hardest filter - please do not apply without it.



Working knowledge of Canva and Nano Banana (or equivalent AI image tools). You should be able to ship a clean landing page hero image without help.



Strong design instincts - you know what a good landing page looks like and you can tell when one is broken.



Enough copywriting know-how to write tight AI prompts and edit AI output critically. You don't need to be a polished native-English copywriter, but you should be able to spot generic or off-brand copy and fix it.



Ability to work independently, juggle priorities, and thrive remotely without micromanagement.





NICE-TO-HAVES (REAL BONUSES)

Paid ads experience (Meta, Google, or similar) and an understanding of conversion tracking.



Video and audio editing for podcasts and promo clips.



Familiarity with other LMS or funnel platforms (Webflow, ClickFunnels, Leadpages, Thinkific, etc.).



Photography or motion design background.





WHY PEOPLE STAY WITH US

You're heard. We work in a low-ego, friendly remote culture where ideas get tested on merit.



Real flexibility. Autonomous schedule, generous time off, and respect for your life outside work.



Real growth. Clear path to full-time, leadership, and performance bonuses - not vague promises.



Meaningful work. Our team is based in Philadelphia, and the content you'll help ship is used by emergency physicians, nurses, and trainees making real clinical decisions.





HOW TO APPLY

Send the following to 



1. A short statement of interest (under 250 words). Begin it with the exact phrase: "I read every word."



2. In 2-3 sentences inside that statement, answer this: if we handed you a Kajabi account on day one with no instructions, what would you Google first? Be specific.



3. Your OnlineJobs.ph profile link.



4. Internet speed test results from speedtest.net (screenshot is fine).



5. A live portfolio link showing landing pages, funnels,
 sequences, or visual assets you have built. This is required, not optional. Applications without a portfolio link will not be considered. If your work is under NDA, send redacted screenshots or a short Loom walkthrough - but send something we can actually look at.



6. References if you have them.



Final candidates will be invited to a short async Loom and a video interview on Google Meet.



We read every application personally. Looking forward to meeting you.
